summary_en: It does not affect rides or the use of electronic money.

title: ランサムウェア被害を受けても「身代金は支払わない」企業の割合が年々増加──JIPDEC調査
summary: ランサムウェア攻撃を受けた場合に犯人グループに身代金を支払う日本企業の割合は年々減少傾向にあることが、日本情報経済社会推進協会の調査で分かった。
title_en: The percentage of companies that “do not pay the ransom” even if they are victimized by ransomware is increasing year by year—JIPDEC survey
summary_en: A survey by the Japan Information Economy and Society Promotion Association found that the percentage of Japanese companies that pay ransoms to criminal groups when attacked by ransomware is decreasing year by year.

title: Google検索「AIモード」に個人情報を入力しないで――立教大など、学内に注意喚起
summary: AIモードに入力した情報はGoogleのデータベースに蓄積され、AI学習に利用されるため、入力自体が情報漏えいになるとし、注意を呼び掛けている。
title_en: Don't enter personal information in Google search "AI mode" -- Rikkyo University and other universities are warning others
summary_en: Since the information entered into AI mode is stored in Google's database and used for AI learning, the company warns users to be careful, saying that input itself can lead to information leaks.

title: 朗報！　Googleが「戻るボタン→広告」がスパムに……次は「×ボタン小さすぎ広告」を何とかしてほしい
summary: 「×」を探しているうちに広告本体を誤タップしてしまい、広告ページに飛ばされてイライラするアレも何とかならないだろうか。
title_en: good news! I want Google to do something about “X button too small ads” next time.
summary_en: I wonder if something can be done about the frustration of accidentally tapping the ad itself while looking for an "X" and being redirected to the ad page.

title: 身に着けるクーラー、酷暑で人気　売上5割増　海外出張で着想　ソニーサーモテクノロジー
summary: 年々、夏の暑さが厳しさを増す中、ソニーグループの新規事業プログラムから誕生した暑熱対策のウェアラブルデバイス「REON POCKET」（レオンポケット）が人気だ。2025年度の売り上げ（事業全体）は、前年比約1.5倍に伸びており、4月に早くも全国100カ所以上で夏日を記録した今年も身に着けるクーラーの注目は高まっている。
title_en: Wearable coolers are popular in extreme heat; sales increase by 50%; idea came from overseas business trip; Sony Thermo Technology
summary_en: As the summer heat gets more intense each year, REON POCKET, a wearable device designed to protect against the heat, was created as part of a new business program by the Sony Group, and has become popular. Sales (overall business) in fiscal 2025 are expected to increase by approximately 1.5 times compared to the previous year, and wearable coolers are attracting increasing attention this year as well, with summer days recorded in more than 100 locations across the country as early as April.

title: 中国人型ロボがハーフマラソンで50分台、人間の世界記録超え　昨年から1時間50分短縮
summary: 中国・北京で19日、人型ロボットが走るハーフマラソン大会が開かれた。優勝タイムは50分26秒で、人間の男子世界記録である57分20秒を大幅に上回った。中国は、2026年を人型ロボットの「商業化元年」と位置付けており、新興産業で先頭集団を走っていると国内外に誇示した。
title_en: Chinese robot runs half marathon in under 50 minutes, beating human world record, 1 hour and 50 minutes shorter than last year
summary_en: A half marathon race run by humanoid robots was held on the 19th in Beijing, China. The winning time was 50 minutes and 26 seconds, significantly faster than the male human world record of 57 minutes and 20 seconds. China has positioned 2026 as the ``first year of commercialization'' of humanoid robots, and has boasted both domestically and internationally that it is leading the way in this emerging industry.

title: 中国でAIエージェント急拡大　「24時間無休の秘書」活用　政府は情報漏えいリスク警戒
summary: 中国で、PC上などでさまざまな作業を自律的にこなすAIを活用したソフトウェア「AIエージェント」の利用が今年に入り急拡大している。人間が関わらずに電子メールの自動返信といった作業を行うことができ、「24時間無休の個人秘書」などともてはやされている。中国IT大手のみならず地方政府も活用を後押しするが、個人情報漏洩（ろうえい）などの問題も浮かぶ。
title_en: Rapid expansion of AI agents in China Utilizes “24/7 secretaries” Government warns of information leak risk
summary_en: In China, the use of AI agents, software that utilizes AI to autonomously perform various tasks on PCs, has been rapidly expanding this year. It can perform tasks such as automatically replying to emails without human intervention, and has been touted as a ``24-hour personal assistant.'' Not only Chinese IT giants but also local governments are supporting its use, but problems such as leaks of personal information arise.

title: OpenAI幹部3人が退社　「Sora」や科学研究部門の縮小が背景か
summary: OpenAIの幹部3人が退社を発表した。「Sora」責任者のビル・ピーブルズ氏、「OpenAI for Science」担当のケビン・ワイル氏、B2Bアプリケーション担当CTOのスリニバス・ナラヤナン氏だ。OpenAIはSoraや科学研究などの「副次的事業」を縮小する方針を固めたと報じられている。
title_en: Three OpenAI executives leave the company, perhaps due to the downsizing of "Sora" and the scientific research department
summary_en: Three OpenAI executives have announced their departure from the company. They are Bill Peebles, head of Sora, Kevin Weil, head of OpenAI for Science, and Srinivas Narayanan, CTO of B2B applications. OpenAI is reported to have decided to reduce its "side businesses" such as Sora and scientific research.

title: 海賊版は良くてメーカーは悪者？ 「ニーア」の勝手サーバ事件で海外勢の意見に驚いたマンガ家が声を大にして言いたいこと
summary: 最近のX（エックス）は国際交流が盛んになっていますが、やはり衝突が起きました。サービスを終了したオンラインゲーム「NieR Re[in]carnation」を巡る議論を見ていて、ボクもかなり驚きました。
title_en: Are pirated copies good and manufacturers bad? What a manga artist wants to say out loud after being surprised by the opinions of foreigners in the "NieR" unauthorized server incident
summary_en: Recently, international exchange has become more active in X, but conflicts have still occurred. I was quite surprised when I was watching the discussion surrounding the online game "NieR Re[in]carnation," which has been discontinued.

title: フェンシング剣の軌跡が光る、追える　東京五輪でも活躍、アニメみたいな可視化技術が米国デビューへ
summary: フェンシング剣の軌跡を光らせ可視化する技術「Fencing Visualized」が、米国で開催される国際大会「WORLD FENCING LEAGUE」で導入される。米国での公開は初という。
title_en: The path of a fencing sword shines and can be followed; animation-like visualization technology makes its U.S. debut at the Tokyo Olympics
summary_en: ``Fencing Visualized,'' a technology that illuminates and visualizes the trajectory of fencing swords, will be introduced at the ``WORLD FENCING LEAGUE,'' an international tournament to be held in the United States. This is the first time it has been released in the United States.

title: ソニーの「サイバーショット」30周年　画期的なデザインと大胆な機構で注目を集めた“あの頃”
summary: 1996年発売の初代サイバーショットは今見てもドキドキするくらい画期的なデザインだった。というわけで、今回はサイバーショット（Cyber-shot）30周年記念コラムである。
title_en: Sony's "Cyber-shot" 30th anniversary - "back then" when it attracted attention with its groundbreaking design and bold mechanism
summary_en: The first generation Cyber-shot, released in 1996, had such a revolutionary design that it still makes my heart skip a beat. So, this time is a column commemorating the 30th anniversary of Cyber-shot.

title: Anthropic、「Opus 4.7」ベースのAIデザインツール「Claude Design」発表　Canvaとの連携も可能
summary: Anthropicは、AIデザインツール「Claude Design」をリサーチプレビューとして発表した。最新モデル「Claude Opus 4.7」を基盤とし、指示やファイルからプロトタイプを自動生成する。Canvaとの提携強化により、生成物をCanvaで直接編集することも可能。プロトタイプから実装まで、業務プロセスのAI統合を加速させる。
title_en: Anthropic announces “Claude Design”, an AI design tool based on “Opus 4.7”, can also be linked with Canva
summary_en: Anthropic announced its AI design tool Claude Design as a research preview. Based on the latest model "Claude Opus 4.7", it automatically generates a prototype from instructions and files. Thanks to our strengthened partnership with Canva, you can also edit your products directly in Canva. Accelerate AI integration in business processes, from prototype to implementation.

title: 岸田元首相、公式YouTubeで自身のディープフェイク映像をセルフパロディー　「この画像は公式です」
summary: 岸田文雄元首相の公式YouTubeチャンネルが4月17日に公開した動画が話題だ。フェイク動画やSNS工作に関する内容だが、そのサムネイルは2023年に話題になった、岸田元首相のディープフェイク動画を模したもの。Xでは岸田元首相に対し「鋼の心過ぎる」と注目を浴びている。
title_en: Former Prime Minister Kishida self-parodies his own deepfake video on official YouTube: ``This image is official''
summary_en: A video released by former Prime Minister Fumio Kishida's official YouTube channel on April 17 has become a hot topic. The content is about fake videos and social media manipulation, but the thumbnail is a copy of a deepfake video of former Prime Minister Kishida that became a hot topic in 2023. In X, former Prime Minister Kishida received attention for having a ``heart of steel.''

title: “100メガショック”再び　「NEOGEO AES＋」11月発売　HDMI出力もある
summary: PLAIONはゲーム機「NEOGEO AES＋」を発表した。SNKが協力し、1990年発売の「NEOGEO」を現代風にアレンジして復活させた。
title_en: “100 MegaShock” returns “NEOGEO AES+” to be released in November HDMI output also available
summary_en: PLAION announced the game console "NEOGEO AES+". With the cooperation of SNK, the ``NEOGEO'' released in 1990 has been revived with a modern twist.

title: 3年前の猛暑再来？　JAMSTECの「地球シミュレータ」、エルニーニョと正のインド洋ダイポールモード現象の同時発生を予測
summary: JAMSTECは17日、スパコン「地球シミュレータ」の最新予測結果として、夏にエルニーニョ現象と正のインド洋ダイポールモード現象が同時発生する可能性があると公表した。世界的な猛暑となった2023年に近い状況になる可能性がある。
title_en: Is the heat wave from 3 years ago back? JAMSTEC's "Earth Simulator" predicts simultaneous occurrence of El Niño and positive Indian Ocean Dipole
summary_en: On the 17th, JAMSTEC announced the latest prediction results from its supercomputer Earth Simulator that there is a possibility that El Niño and a positive Indian Ocean Dipole will occur simultaneously in the summer. There is a possibility that the situation will be similar to that of 2023, when there was a global heatwave.

title: ソフトバンク、米新興のAIスマホを1年間の国内独占販売　“ユーザーの行動先読み”うたう「Natural AI Phone」
summary: ソフトバンクは4月17日、AI機能搭載スマートフォン「Natural AI Phone」を国内で販売すると発表した。同日に予約受付を始め、24日から国内で1年間独占販売する。
title_en: Softbank will exclusively sell emerging American AI smartphones in Japan for one year - "Natural AI Phone", which claims to "predict user behavior"
summary_en: Softbank announced on April 17th that it will sell a smartphone with AI functions, ``Natural AI Phone,'' in Japan. Pre-orders will begin on the same day, and exclusive sales will begin in Japan for one year from the 24th.

title: Cloudflare、全サービスに対応するCLI開発へ　AIエージェントへの最適化目指す
summary: 米Cloudflareは、AIエージェントによる利用を最適化するため、同社が提供するすべてのサービスに対応したコマンドラインインターフェイス（CLI）を開発することを明らかにしました。
title_en: Cloudflare to develop CLI compatible with all services, aiming to optimize for AI agents
summary_en: Cloudflare has announced that it will develop a command line interface (CLI) for all of its services to optimize use by AI agents.

title: シャオミ、タブレット値上げ　最大32％、メモリ高騰など背景
summary: AI需要の急増に伴う部材価格の高騰やサプライチェーンコストの増加、為替変動などを理由に挙げている。
title_en: Xiaomi raises tablet prices by up to 32%, background of soaring memory prices, etc.
summary_en: The reasons cited include soaring component prices due to the rapid increase in demand for AI, increased supply chain costs, and exchange rate fluctuations.

title: スマホOS事業者の他社AI排除を警戒　公取委が実態調査報告書　米大手に懸念表明
summary: 公正取引委員会は4月16日、生成AI市場の実態調査に関する報告書を公表した。スマートフォン端末の生成AIを使うアプリを開発しようとする企業に対し、基本ソフト（OS）を提供する企業がソフトウェアへのアクセスを制限すれば独禁法に抵触しかねないと示した。生成AIを利用した自動運転を巡っては、米中の大手企業などが国内企業との公正競争を阻害する懸念があると指摘した。
title_en: Wary of smartphone OS operators excluding AI from other companies; FTC reports fact-finding report; expresses concerns to major U.S. companies
summary_en: On April 16th, the Fair Trade Commission released a report on the actual state of the generative AI market. It indicated that if a company that provides the basic software (OS) restricts access to the software for companies trying to develop apps that use AI generated by smartphone devices, it could violate antitrust laws. Regarding self-driving cars using generative AI, major companies in the United States and China pointed out that there are concerns that they may impede fair competition with domestic companies.

title: DJI、「Osmo Pocket 4」正式発表　4K/240fpsやズームボタン追加　7万7660円から
summary: 中国DJIは4月16日、3軸ジンバルを内蔵した小型カメラ「Osmo Pocket 4」を発表した。前モデルのデザインを継承しつつ、4K/240fpsのスローモーション撮影や強力な被写体追尾機能に対応した。発売は4月22日を予定しており、価格は7万7660円（エッセンシャルコンボ）から。
title_en: DJI officially announces "Osmo Pocket 4" 4K/240fps and zoom button added starting from 77,660 yen
summary_en: On April 16, China's DJI announced the Osmo Pocket 4, a small camera with a built-in 3-axis gimbal. While inheriting the design of the previous model, it now supports 4K/240fps slow-motion shooting and powerful subject tracking functions. Release is scheduled for April 22nd, and prices start from 77,660 yen (Essential Combo).

title: 「ハンディカム」唯一の現行モデルが生産完了に　ソニー「後継は未定」
summary: ソニーストアの「FDR-AX45A」商品ページに「生産完了」と表記されたことが、SNSなどで話題になっている。ただしソニーによると今回はあくまでも1機種の生産完了だという。
title_en: Production of the only current "Handycam" model has ended; Sony "successor undecided"
summary_en: The fact that the Sony Store's "FDR-AX45A" product page was marked as "out of production" has become a hot topic on social media. However, according to Sony, production of only one model has been completed this time.

title: スマホが決め手　京都府警が養父の行動履歴を分析、捜索範囲絞り安達結希さんの遺体を発見
summary: 都府南丹市で市立園部小の安達結希さんが3月から行方不明となり遺体で見つかった事件で、京都府警が結希さんが行方不明になった時期の養父の安達優季容疑者のスマートフォンなどの行動履歴を分析し、遺体の発見につながったことが4月16日、捜査関係者への取材で分かった。
title_en: Smartphone was the deciding factor: Kyoto Prefectural Police analyzed her adoptive father's behavioral history, narrowed down the search area, and found Yuki Adachi's body
summary_en: In the case of Yuki Adachi, a student at Municipal Sonobe Elementary School in Nantan City, Tokyo, who had been missing since March, her body was found.On April 16, interviews with investigators revealed that Kyoto Prefectural Police analyzed the smartphone and other activity history of Yuki's adoptive father, Yuki Adachi, around the time she went missing, leading to the discovery of her body.

title: 東プレ製「万」「円」「訂正」キーストラップ、セブン銀がプレゼントへ　ATMの打鍵感再現
summary: ストラップ、キーボードとも、セブンATMテンキーを手掛ける東プレが制作。おなじみの打鍵感が味わえる。
title_en: Topre's ``10,000'', ``Yen'', and ``Correction'' key straps are presented by Seven Silver, reproducing the feeling of pressing an ATM key.
summary_en: Both the strap and keyboard are produced by Topre, the same company that produces the Seven ATM numeric keypad. You can enjoy the familiar feel of keystrokes.

title: 「インスタ用にして」テキスト指令でAdobeCCが自律的に動く　「Firefly AIアシスタント」　Claudeからも利用可能
summary: 画像をアップロードし、「Instagram広告用に整えて」「マグカップ用にして」などと指示するだけで、CCアプリを横断した作業をAIが自動で実行する。
title_en: Adobe CC moves autonomously with text commands such as “Make it for Instagram” “Firefly AI Assistant” also available from Claude
summary_en: Just upload an image and give instructions such as ``Arrange it for an Instagram ad'' or ``Arrange it for a mug,'' and the AI ​​will automatically perform tasks across CC apps.

title: Anthropic、本人確認機能を導入　悪用防止とコンプライアンス強化で
summary: Anthropicは、悪用防止や法的義務の順守を目的に、一部のユースケースで本人確認機能を導入した。外部パートナーのPersona Identitiesを通じて政府発行の身分証と自撮り写真による照合を行う。収集データは本人確認のみに使用され、AIモデルの学習には利用されないとしている。
title_en: Anthropic introduces identity verification function to prevent abuse and strengthen compliance
summary_en: Anthropic has introduced identity verification for some use cases to prevent abuse and comply with legal obligations. Through our external partner Persona Identities, we will match government-issued ID cards with selfies. The collected data will be used only for identity verification and will not be used to train the AI ​​model.

title: クラファン「うぶごえ」が閲覧できない状態に　支払い遅延の指摘も
summary: クラウドファンディングサイトの「うぶごえ」が、閲覧できない状態になっているとして、プロジェクト実行者や支援者の間に動揺が広がっている。
title_en: Clafan ``Ubugoe'' is no longer viewable, with some pointing out payment delays
summary_en: The crowdfunding site ``Ubugoe'' has become unviewable, causing agitation among project proponents and supporters.

title: ニセ刑事に騙されて国税職員が個人企業の納税情報をLINEで漏えい「潔白証明したかった」
summary: 大阪国税局は4月15日、課税1部の20代職員が税務署での勤務中、電話をかけてきた警察官を名乗る男のうそを信じ、個人や企業計259者の納税情報を漏らしたと発表した。職員は国税局の聞き取りに「身の潔白を証明するため、言われるがままになってしまった」と話したという。警察官をかたる特殊詐欺被害は近年、全国で多発している。
title_en: A national tax official was tricked by a fake detective into leaking personal company tax information on LINE, saying he wanted to prove his innocence.
summary_en: On April 15, the Osaka Regional Taxation Bureau announced that an employee in his 20s in the First Taxation Department believed the lies of a man who called him claiming to be a police officer while he was working at the tax office, and leaked the tax information of a total of 259 individuals and companies. When interviewed by the National Tax Bureau, the employee reportedly said, ``I did as I was told to prove my innocence.'' In recent years, victims of special scams pretending to be police officers have been occurring frequently across the country.

title: 「Snapchat」のSnap、従業員1000人を削減　AIによる「業務変革」で2026年の黒字化狙う
summary: SnapのシュピーゲルCEOは、全従業員の約16％に当たる約1000人の解雇を発表した。AI活用による業務変革を推進し、新規コードの65％をAIで生成するなど徹底した効率化を図る。2026年中の黒字化とMAU10億人の達成を目標に掲げ、広告基盤の強化やデバイス事業への投資を継続し、持続的な成長を目指す方針だ。
title_en: Snapchat's Snap cuts 1,000 employees, aims to return to profitability in 2026 through AI-powered "business transformation"
summary_en: Snap CEO Spiegel announced the layoffs of about 1,000 people, or about 16% of the company's total workforce. We will promote business transformation through the use of AI, and aim to thoroughly improve efficiency by generating 65% of new code with AI. The company aims to become profitable and reach 1 billion MAUs by the end of 2026, and aims to achieve sustainable growth by strengthening its advertising base and continuing to invest in its device business.

title: Windows版「Googleアプリ」に続きMac版の「Geminiアプリ」も登場　ショートカットでGemini呼び出し
summary: Googleは、デスクトップからGeminiや検索機能を即座に呼び出せるWindows版「Googleアプリ」およびMac版「Geminiアプリ」を公開した。ショートカット操作や画面共有による文脈理解、「AI Mode」での応答に対応する。Mac版はApple Silicon専用で画像と動画の生成が可能。Windows版はローカルファイル検索やGoogleレンズを搭載している。
title_en: Following the Windows version of the Google app, the Mac version of the Gemini app is now available. Call Gemini with a shortcut
summary_en: Google has released a Windows version of the Google app and a Mac version of the Gemini app, which allow you to instantly access Gemini and search functions from your desktop. It supports shortcut operations, context understanding through screen sharing, and responses in "AI Mode." The Mac version is exclusive to Apple Silicon and can generate images and videos. The Windows version includes local file search and Google Lens.

title: コンソールポチポチが好きだけどIaCやってます
summary:
コンソールポチポチは良い
私はAWSマネジメントコンソールが好きです。
新しいサービスを試すとき、まずコンソールを開きます。画面を見ながら「このサービスにはこんな設定項目があるのか」「この項目はこう関連しているのか」と理解していく。ドキュメントを読むだけでは掴めない感覚が、画面を触ると分かることがあります。
コンソールの良さはいくつもあります。
すぐ試せて、すぐ壊せる。 検証したいことがあるとき、コンソールなら数クリックでリソースを作って動作を確認できます。うまくいかなければ消してやり直せばいい。このサイクルの速さは、学習でも検証でも大きな武器です。
何ができるか分かる。 コンソール...
title_en: I like playing consoles, but I'm doing IaC.
summary_en:
Console click is good
I like the AWS Management Console.
When trying out a new service, first open the console. While looking at the screen, I try to understand things like, ``Does this service have these setting items?'' and ``Are these items related?'' ただ、実務を重ねるほど、「毎回そこまでやるのが本当に最適なのか？」という疑問も出てきました。
特に小〜中規模の開発では、将来の拡張性のために入れた抽象化が、今の開発速度やコード理解のしやすさをむしろ下げることがあります。この記事では、クリーンアーキテクチャを否定するのではなく、Reposito...
title_en: It may be better not to interface the repository layer.
summary_en:
"Repository is an interface"
I honestly believed that at first too.
If you learn about clean architecture and DDD, you will see a clean configuration in which Repository is defined with an interface, the implementation is separated, and the configuration is injected with DI. In fact, there are situations where the design fits perfectly.

title: 「宇宙は極低温だから放熱が楽」は本当か？　宇宙データセンターの実現に欠かせない冷却の話
title_en: Is it true that "space is extremely cold, so heat dissipation is easy"? The story of cooling, which is essential to realizing a space data center
summary: 「宇宙空間は真空で冷たく、AI半導体のような高発熱機器も地上より楽に冷やせるのではないか」――そんな直感から、軌道上データセンター構想を合理的な未来像として語る言説もある。だが実際の宇宙機開発では、熱をどう集め、どう運び、どう捨てるかは、今もなお難しい課題だ。
summary_en: ``Outer space is a vacuum and cold, and high-heating devices such as AI semiconductors can be cooled more easily than on the ground.'' Based on this intuition, some people talk about the idea of ​​an orbital data center as a rational vision of the future. However, in actual spacecraft development, how to collect, transport, and dissipate heat remains a difficult issue.

title: OpenAIとMicrosoft、提携契約を再改定　OpenAIはAWSなど任意のクラウドで製品提供可能に

summary_en: OpenAI and Microsoft have updated their partnership. OpenAI will be able to sell its technology on clouds other than Azure, ending its exclusive provision of APIs. Microsoft's revenue sharing with OpenAI will end, but OpenAI's revenue sharing with Microsoft will continue. The two companies will accelerate their multi-cloud strategy, including partnering with other companies, while ensuring flexibility.

title: 「LoL」はどれくらい脳機能を向上させる？　5カ月遊んだ68人の脳を分析、他ゲームと比較　学術誌に掲載

summary_en: The paper ``Effects of Video Game Type on Cognitive Performance and Brain Functional Connectivity: A Longitudinal EEG Study'' published in the journal Brain Sciences by researchers affiliated with the University of Electronic Science and Technology in China is a research report that analyzes how different video game genres affect the brain.

title: なぜ燃えるモバイルバッテリー　旅客機内は使用禁止に　"非常識"な「中華電池」も登場
title_en: Why burning mobile batteries are banned from use on passenger planes; ``insane'' Chinese batteries also appear
summary: モバイルバッテリーが発火する事故が相次ぎ、国土交通省は24日から旅客機内での使用を禁止する安全基準の適用を始めた。スマートフォンなど小型電子機器の高機能化もあり、モバイルバッテリーでの手軽な充電の需要は高まる一方だが、ひとたび発火すれば大きな被害につながりかねない。市場では安価な海外製も多く流通しているが、価格は多少割高でも安全性を重視した日本製の存在感が増している。
summary_en: After a series of accidents involving mobile batteries catching fire, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism began enforcing safety standards on the 24th that prohibit their use on passenger planes. As small electronic devices such as smartphones become more sophisticated, the demand for easy charging with mobile batteries is increasing, but once a fire ignites, it can cause major damage. Although there are many inexpensive overseas-made products on the market, the presence of Japanese-made products that emphasize safety, even if they are a little more expensive, is increasing.

title: 中国EVの猛攻にさらされる欧州　新車販売の1割が中国製　追加関税も骨抜きに

summary_en: The European Union (EU) is facing an uphill battle due to the onslaught of Chinese-made electric vehicles (EVs). In 2024, additional tariffs were imposed on Chinese-made EVs, raising the tax rate to a maximum of 45.3% due to China's unfair subsidies, but the momentum of exports has not stopped.

title: 脳を老化させる“新たな一因”特定、減らすと記憶力が回復　2025年夏にNature系列誌で研究掲載

summary: 米カリフォルニア大学サンフランシスコ校などに所属する研究者らがNature Aging誌で発表した論文「Targeting iron-associated protein Ftl1 in the brain of old mice improves age-related cognitive impairment」は、脳の老化を促進する「FTL1」と呼ばれるタンパク質を特定し、その量
summary_en: The paper "Targeting iron-associated protein Ftl1 in the brain of old mice improves age-related cognitive impairment" published in the journal Nature Aging by researchers affiliated with the University of California, San Francisco, USA, identifies a protein called "FTL1" that accelerates brain aging, and determines its amount.

Adopts the latest "Graviton 5" to streamline CPU-intensive processing such as inference, code generation, and autonomous task adjustment. The company's policy is to diversify its AI infrastructure and improve energy efficiency to strengthen the foundation for next-generation AI development.

title: ナトリウムイオン電池、前から飛行機に持ち込み不可だった　エレコムが訂正と謝罪
title_en: ELECOM corrects and apologizes for sodium ion batteries that were previously not allowed on planes
summary: エレコムは1日、ナトリウムイオン電池の航空機内への持ち込みについて、4月28日に発表した内容に誤りがあったとして謝罪、訂正した。
summary_en: On the 1st, ELECOM apologized and corrected an error in the content announced on April 28 regarding the carry-on of sodium ion batteries onto aircraft.

title: LINEの“iOS／Android間でも履歴完全移行”機能にまた不具合、一部履歴が復元できず　公開鍵の保存不備で
title_en: There is another problem with LINE's "complete history migration between iOS/Android" function, some history cannot be restored due to insufficient storage of public key
summary: プレミアムバックアップをめぐっては、登録時に、意図せずLINEパスワードが上書きされる不具合が公表されたばかりだ。
summary_en: Regarding Premium Backup, it has just been announced that there is an issue where LINE passwords are unintentionally overwritten during registration.

title: イエローハット子会社で最大345万人分の情報漏えいか　データ持ち出しの痕跡確認
title_en: Information on up to 3.45 million people was leaked at a Yellow Hat subsidiary; traces of data exfiltration confirmed
summary: イエローハットは5月1日、オートバイ用品チェーンを展開する子会社の２りんかんイエローハット（埼玉県和光市）で発生した不正アクセスを巡り、最大で345万件超の情報が持ち出された痕跡を確認したと発表した。
summary_en: On May 1st, Yellow Hat announced that it had discovered evidence that up to 3.45 million pieces of information had been stolen due to unauthorized access that occurred at its subsidiary 2rinkan Yellow Hat (Wako City, Saitama Prefecture), which operates a motorcycle supplies chain.

title_en: Introducing “Irasutoya Maker” Can you freely customize parts and avoid “overlapping”?
summary: フリー素材サイト「いらすとや」を運営するみふねたかし氏は5月1日、パーツを組み合わせて自由にキャラクターを作成できる新サービス「いらすとやメーカー」を公開した。同サービスで作成した画像は商用利用も可能だ。
summary_en: On May 1st, Takashi Mifune, who runs the free material site ``Irasutoya,'' released ``Irasutoya Maker,'' a new service that allows users to freely create characters by combining parts. Images created with this service can also be used for commercial purposes.

title: 東証、KDDIに違約金9120万円　子会社の架空取引で「投資者の信頼を損なった」
title_en: TSE imposes penalty of 91.2 million yen on KDDI for fictitious trading at subsidiary company for ``losing investor trust''
summary: 東証は問題の背景として、KDDIが広告代理事業を「非中核・傍流事業」と位置付け、全社的に知見が不足していた点などを指摘している。
summary_en: The TSE points out that the reason for the problem is that KDDI has positioned the advertising agency business as a "non-core/sideline business" and that there was a lack of company-wide knowledge.

title: WBC独占配信のNetflix、期間中に「eo」通信量10倍に　需要押し上げに効果
title_en: Netflix exclusively distributed by WBC, "eo" communication volume increased 10 times during period, effective in boosting demand
summary: 3月に東京など世界各地を会場に開催されたワールド・ベースボール・クラシック（WBC）を米Netflixが日本で独占生配信した結果、関西電力グループのオプテージが提供する光回線サービス「eo」で大会期間中、動画配信サービス向け通信量が通常時の約10倍に達したことが分かった。
summary_en: As a result of Netflix's exclusive live streaming of the World Baseball Classic (WBC) in Japan, which was held in Tokyo and other locations around the world in March, it was revealed that during the tournament, the amount of traffic for video distribution services on the optical fiber service ``eo'' provided by Kansai Electric Power Group's Optage reached approximately 10 times the normal amount.

title: 次世代通信IOWN、今秋に中国、九州でも開始　NTT西社長、万博跡地開発参入に意欲
title_en: Next-generation communication IOWN will start in China and Kyushu this fall; NTT West president is keen to participate in the development of the Expo site
summary: NTT西日本の北村亮太社長は産経新聞社のインタビューに応じ、大阪・関西万博の通信インフラとして提供した次世代通信基盤「IOWN（アイオン）」を活用した法人向けサービスを、現在の関西と中部に加えて今秋には中国、九州地方の大都市エリアでも開始すると明らかにした。また万博の跡地開発への参入を目指す方針を重ねて示し、インフラ整備に加えサイネージ（電子掲示板）などのサービス提供に意欲を示した。
summary_en: Ryota Kitamura, president of NTT West, said in an interview with the Sankei Shimbun that the company will begin offering corporate services using the next-generation communications platform "IOWN," which was provided as the communications infrastructure for the Osaka-Kansai Expo, in major metropolitan areas in Chugoku and Kyushu this fall, in addition to the current Kansai and Chubu regions. The company also reiterated its intention to enter into the development of the World Expo site, and expressed its desire to provide services such as signage (electronic bulletin board) in addition to infrastructure development.

title: Web会議のブイキューブ、上場廃止へ　“コロナ後”の舵取りに失敗

title: OpenAI、「ChatGPT」に物理キー対応の高度なセキュリティ機能「AAS」を導入
title_en: OpenAI introduces advanced security function “AAS” that supports physical keys to “ChatGPT”
summary: OpenAIは、ChatGPTユーザー向けの保護機能「Advanced Account Security」を発表した。パスキーや物理キーによる認証を導入し、アカウント回復手段を制限することで安全性を高める。有効化によりAI学習の対象からも自動で除外される。Yubicoとの提携による専用キーの優待販売も実施し、全ユーザーが利用可能だ。
summary_en: OpenAI announced Advanced Account Security, a protection feature for ChatGPT users. Increase security by introducing authentication using passkeys and physical keys and limiting account recovery methods. By enabling it, it will also be automatically excluded from AI learning. In partnership with Yubico, we are also conducting special sales of special keys, which are available to all users.

title: Spotifyが人間アーティスト認証バッジ導入──AI生成コンテンツとの識別を強化
title_en: Spotify introduces human artist verification badge ─ strengthens identification with AI-generated content
summary: Spotifyは、人間のアーティストであることを示す認証バッジ「Verified by Spotify」の導入を発表した。認証にはリスナーの持続的な支持などの実在証跡が必要で、AIアーティストは対象外。判定にはアルゴリズムと人間によるレビューを組み合わせる。
summary_en: Spotify has announced the introduction of Verified by Spotify, a verification badge that identifies you as a human artist. Authentication requires real evidence such as sustained support from listeners, and AI artists are not eligible. Judgments are made using a combination of algorithms and human reviews.

title: なぜ「BeReal」から漏えいが相次ぐのか　“2分以内”の焦りが生む不用意な投稿
title_en: Why are there so many leaks from “BeReal”? Careless posts caused by impatience within “2 minutes”
summary: BeRealがなぜ漏えいにつながるのか。使い方を誤らなければ楽しいSNSだが、「投稿を焦らせるUI」と「友人しか見ていない」という思い込みと油断が、不適切な投稿につながっている。
summary_en: Why does BeReal lead to leaks? SNS is fun if you don't use it incorrectly, but the UI that makes you rush to post, the assumption that only your friends are seeing it, and being careless can lead to inappropriate posts.

title: Google搭載車でも「Gemini」　自然な会話でナビやメッセージ送信が可能に
title_en: "Gemini" allows you to navigate and send messages with natural conversations even in Google-equipped cars
summary: Googleは、「Android OS」を車両に直接組み込んだ「Google搭載車」向けに、AIアシスタント「Gemini」の提供を開始すると発表した。従来のGoogleアシスタントに代わり、自然な会話形式でナビやメッセージ管理、音楽再生、車両設定の変更などが行えるようになる。まずは米国の英語ユーザーから展開し、順次拡大していく計画だ。
summary_en: Google announced that it will start providing its AI assistant, Gemini, for Google-equipped cars that have Android OS installed directly into the vehicle. Instead of the traditional Google Assistant, users will be able to navigate, manage messages, play music, change vehicle settings, and more in a natural conversational manner. The plan is to start with English-language users in the United States and gradually expand.

title: Apple、3月期として過去最高の売上高　電話会見に次期CEOが初参加
title_en: Apple records record sales for March; incoming CEO participates in conference call for the first time
summary: Appleの1～3月期決算は、売上高と純利益ともに2桁台の増加で3月気として過去最高を更新した。決算発表後の電話会見に次期CEOのジョン・ターナス氏が初めて参加し、現在の財務方針を継続する意向を示した。
summary_en: Apple's financial results for the January-March period set new record highs for March, with both sales and net income increasing by double digits. Incoming CEO John Tarnas participated for the first time in a conference call following the announcement of financial results, and expressed his intention to continue with the company's current financial policy.

title: 創業80年の企業も「BeReal」不適切投稿で謝罪　取引先が巻き込まれ対応に苦慮
title_en: 80-year-old company apologizes for inappropriate post on "BeReal"; business partners are involved and struggles to respond
summary: 1945年創業の建設機械部品の製造販売会社、森康は30日、社員がSNSアプリ「BeReal」を不適切に利用し、社内や関係者の情報が外部に公開されたと明らかにした。
summary_en: Moriyasu, a company that manufactures and sells construction machinery parts and was founded in 1945, announced on the 30th that an employee had inappropriately used the SNS app BeReal, and information about the company and related parties had been disclosed to the outside world.

title: 羽田空港で人型ロボが作業へ、JALとGMOが3年間の実証実験　空港の地上業務を代行
title_en: Humanoid robots begin work at Haneda Airport, JAL and GMO conduct ground operations for the airport in 3-year demonstration experiment
summary: 日本航空（JAL）は4月27日、同グループのJALグランドサービス（東京都大田区）とGMO AI＆ロボティクス商事（東京都渋谷区）が、国内初となる空港業務での人型ロボットの実証実験を羽田空港で開始すると発表した。
summary_en: Japan Airlines (JAL) announced on April 27 that the group's JAL Ground Service (Ota-ku, Tokyo) and GMO AI & Robotics Shoji (Shibuya-ku, Tokyo) will begin Japan's first demonstration experiment of humanoid robots for airport operations at Haneda Airport.

title: 「BeReal」による不適切投稿、教育現場でも　20代女性教諭「深く考えず投稿した」
title_en: Inappropriate posts by "BeReal", even in the educational field, female teacher in her 20s "posted without thinking deeply"
summary: 仙台市教育委員会は、太白区内の市立小学校に勤める教員の一人が、不適切なSNS投稿を行っていたと公表した。
summary_en: The Sendai City Board of Education announced that one of the teachers working at a municipal elementary school in Taihaku Ward had posted inappropriate social media posts.

title: テスラ自動運転「26年中に日本解禁」の現実味──日産・NVIDIAも参戦、一番乗りはどこか
title_en: The reality of Tesla autonomous driving ``to be lifted in Japan in 2026'' -- Nissan and NVIDIA are also participating, who will be the first?
summary: オランダで認可、26年中の日本実装も宣言したテスラのFSD Supervised。だが立ちはだかるのは経産省の「E2Eブラックボックス」問題だ。日産＋Wayve、NVIDIA Alpamayoも参戦する市街地ADASの陣取り合戦。技術論を超えた政治判断まで絡む日本市場で、最初に解禁されるのはどのシステムか。
summary_en: Tesla's FSD Supervised has been approved in the Netherlands and has announced that it will be implemented in Japan in 2026. However, what stands in the way is the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry's ``E2E black box'' issue. A battle for urban ADAS positions in which Nissan + Wayve and NVIDIA Alpamayo also participate. Which system will be released first in the Japanese market, which involves political decisions that go beyond technical theory?

title: “BeReal漏えい問題”で西日本シティ銀のサイトつながりにくく　ネットバンクは親会社サイト経由で利用を
title_en: Difficult to connect to Nishi-Nippon City Bank's website due to "BeReal leak issue" Online banking is now available via the parent company's website
summary: No Summary Available
summary_en: No Summary Available

title: 「高熱のときに見る夢」　マスク氏やザッカーバーグ氏の“顔”が4足で歩く、不気味なロボット犬がSNSで話題
title_en: "Dreams you have when you have a high fever" A creepy robot dog with the faces of Mr. Musk and Mr. Zuckerberg walking on four legs is a hot topic on social media
summary: テック界の大物達の顔と犬の体とを組み合わせた「ロボット犬」の存在が、XなどのSNSを中心に話題となっている。
summary_en: The existence of ``robot dogs'' that combine the faces of big names in the tech world with the bodies of dogs has become a hot topic on social networking sites such as X.

title: UberがExpediaと提携　アプリ内ホテル予約「Hotels on Uber」など新機能を発表
title_en: Uber partners with Expedia and announces new features including in-app hotel reservation “Hotels on Uber”
summary: Uberが年次イベント「GO-GET 2026」で多数の新機能を発表した。Expediaとの提携によるアプリ内ホテル予約「Hotels on Uber」では、70万以上の宿泊施設に対応予定。旅行先で現地情報を提供する「Travel Mode」や、海外でも「Uber One」特典を利用できる「Uber One Internationalなども発表した。
summary_en: Uber announced a number of new features at its annual event "GO-GET 2026." Hotels on Uber, an in-app hotel booking service in partnership with Expedia, will cover over 700,000 accommodations. They also announced ``Travel Mode,'' which provides local information at travel destinations, and ``Uber One International,'' which allows you to use Uber One benefits overseas.

title: 銀行員が支店内でBeReal投稿した映像、Xで拡散　西日本シティ銀が謝罪　顧客7人の氏名が流出
title_en: Video posted by a bank employee on BeReal inside the branch spread on X Nishi-Nippon City Bank apologizes; names of 7 customers leaked
summary: 動画は銀行の支店内とみられる場所で主に撮影されており、文字がぎっしり書かれたホワイトボードやデスク上の書類、PC画面などが映り込んでいた。
summary_en: The video was mainly filmed in what appears to be a bank branch, and shows a whiteboard filled with writing, documents on a desk, and a computer screen.

title: 銀行員が支店内部を撮影？　BeReal映像がXで拡散　西日本シティ銀「事実確認中」
title_en: Did a bank employee take pictures of the inside of the branch? BeReal video spread on X Nishinippon City Bank “Checking the facts”
summary: 同行はITmediaNEWSの取材に対して「SNSの投稿は認識しており、事実確認中」とコメントした。
summary_en: In response to an interview with ITmediaNEWS, the bank commented, ``We are aware of the SNS post and are currently verifying the facts.''

title: 従業員5人で12カ国とやり取り、とある国内ニッチメーカーの海外戦略　カギは”回路図のデジタル化”
title_en: A certain domestic niche manufacturer's overseas strategy, with 5 employees communicating with 12 countries, the key is "digitization of circuit diagrams"
summary: グローバルニッチは高い技術力を持つ一方で、知名度が実力に比べて劣り、ITを駆使して海外でのブランディングや販売に生かしていることも多い。この連載では、こうした企業のIT戦略をインタビューで深堀りする。今回はダイカスト（金型に溶かした金属を注入し、短時間で成型する鋳造技術や製品）向け周辺設備の設計・製造を手掛ける真岐興業に注目。
summary_en: While global niche companies have high technological capabilities, their name recognition is inferior to their actual capabilities, and they often make full use of IT for branding and sales overseas. In this series, we will dig deeper into the IT strategies of these companies through interviews. This time, we are focusing on Maki Kogyo, which designs and manufactures peripheral equipment for die casting (casting technology and products that are formed by injecting molten metal into a mold in a short time).

title: Meta、2桁台の増収増益　AI投資拡大で設備投資見通しを上方修正
title_en: Meta achieves double-digit sales and profit increases; capital investment outlook revised upward due to expansion of AI investment
summary: Metaの1月～3月期決算は、売上高が前年同期比33％増、純利益が61％増と大幅な増収増益だった。広告事業が好調な一方、Reality Labsは赤字が続く。ザッカーバーグCEOは「Muse」モデルの成果を強調し、AIインフラ拡充のため通期の設備投資予測を上方修正した。
summary_en: Meta's financial results for the January-March period showed significant increases in sales and profits, with sales up 33% and net profit up 61% year-on-year. While the advertising business is doing well, Reality Labs continues to be in the red. CEO Zuckerberg emphasized the results of the "Muse" model and upwardly revised the full-year capital investment forecast to expand AI infrastructure.

title: Amazon決算、AWS売上高28％増で成長率が過去15四半期最速に　Anthropicの投資益で純利益は大幅増
title_en: Amazon results, AWS sales increase 28%, fastest growth rate in 15 quarters, net income increases significantly due to Anthropic investment gain
summary: Amazonの1～3月期決算は、売上高は前年同期比17％増、純利益はAnthropicへの投資に関連する評価益を含め77％増の大幅増益となった。クラウド部門のAWSは過去15四半期で最速の成長を記録し、生成AI需要に対応するための設備投資も拡大。ジャシーCEOはAIによる顧客体験の再構築に自信を示した。
summary_en: Amazon's financial results for the January-March period showed a 17% increase in sales compared to the same period last year, and a 77% increase in net profit, including a valuation gain related to the investment in Anthropic. AWS, the cloud sector, recorded its fastest growth in 15 quarters, with increased capital spending to meet the demand for generative AI. CEO Jassy expressed confidence in the ability to reimagine the customer experience through AI.

title: なぜ一部のAIモデルは「日本文化」に執着するのか？　「4o-mini」などの出力が日本に偏る実態、欧州チームが研究発表
title_en: Why are some AI models obsessed with "Japanese culture"? European team presents research on the fact that the output of "4o-mini" etc. is biased towards Japan
summary: スペインのバスク大学や英カーディフ大学などに所属する研究者らが発表した論文「Why are all LLMs Obsessed with Japanese Culture? On the Hidden Cultural and Regional Biases of LLMs」は、一部のAIモデルが文化的な話題において日本文化に強い執着を見せることが明らかにした研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``Why are all LLMs Obsessed with Japanese Culture? On the Hidden Cultural and Regional Biases of LLMs,'' published by researchers affiliated with the University of the Basque Country in Spain and Cardiff University in the UK, is a research report that reveals that some AI models show a strong obsession with Japanese culture when it comes to cultural topics.

title: Alphabet、売上高22％増の1099億ドル　AI需要拡大でGoogle Cloudが初の200億ドル超え
title_en: Alphabet's revenue increases by 22% to $109.9 billion; Google Cloud becomes the first company to exceed $20 billion due to growing demand for AI
summary: Alphabetの1～3月期決算は、売上高は22％増の1098億9600万ドル、純利益は81％増の625億7800万ドルと大幅な増収増益となった。Google Cloudが初めて200億ドルを突破。AI需要に対応するため、2026年通期の設備投資見通しを最大1900億ドルに引き上げた。
summary_en: Alphabet's financial results for the January-March period showed a significant increase in sales and profits, with sales increasing 22% to $109,896 million and net profit increasing 81% to $62,578 million. Google Cloud surpasses $20 billion for the first time. To meet the demand for AI, the company has raised its capital investment outlook for the full year of 2026 to up to $190 billion.

title: そこにいない猫の「モフモフ」と「呼吸」を手で感じられる装置　“癒やし効果”は……東大が研究発表
title_en: A device that allows you to feel the fluffiness and breathing of a cat who is not there has a ``healing effect''... University of Tokyo releases research
summary: 東京大学に所属する研究者らがCHI 2026で発表した論文「Touching a Cat Without Touch: Does Mid-Air Ultrasound Haptic Feedback Promote Relaxation in Virtual Cat Interaction?」は、空中超音波を使ってVR空間の猫と触れ合う体験を開発し、そのリラックス効果を検証した研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``Touching a Cat Without Touch: Does Mid-Air Ultrasound Haptic Feedback Promote Relaxation in Virtual Cat Interaction?'' published by researchers affiliated with the University of Tokyo at CHI 2026 is a research report that developed an experience of interacting with a cat in a VR space using aerial ultrasound and verified its relaxing effect.

title: Microsoft、AI事業の年率換算売上が370億ドル突破　Azureは40％増
title_en: Microsoft's annualized sales of AI business exceed $37 billion, Azure increased by 40%
summary: Microsoftの1～3月期決算は、売上高は前年同期比18％増の828億8600万ドル、純利益は23％増の317億7800万ドル。AIビジネスの年間売上高ランレートは370億ドルを突破し前年比123％増。設備投資は84％増の308億ドルに達した。
summary_en: Microsoft's financial results for the January-March period showed sales of $82.886 billion, an 18% increase from the same period last year, and net income of $31.778 billion, an increase of 23%. The annual revenue run rate of AI Business exceeded $37 billion, an increase of 123% year-on-year. Capital spending increased by 84% to $30.8 billion.

title: 【最終話】漫画「1週間後に生成AIで恥をかく新入社員」
title_en: [Final episode] Manga “New employee embarrassed by generated AI after one week”
summary: とある企業に入社した新入社員「ニイジマ」が、AI活用の“地雷”を踏みまくっていく様子を通して、会社におけるAIの使い方、その初歩を紹介します。

summary_en:
Introduction
When sensitive information gets mixed into GitHub, the first action you should take is not to delete the history. The order of response will vary greatly depending on what the leak is. In this article, assuming GitHub Enterprise Cloud or GitHub Enterprise Server, we will explain the mechanism to stop confidential information from being mixed in, and the work to remove the remnants after it has been mixed in, with a level of granularity that can be reproduced using commands at hand.
The relevant GitHub Docs page states that if the leaked credentials are credentials, the first thing to do is to disable or rotate them. If you can disable it, you may not have to go as far as rewriting the history. ...

title: 車から人型へ50秒で変形、全長4.7mの乗用ロボ「SR-01」に乗ってきた　まるでトランスフォーマー？
title_en: I rode the SR-01, a 4.7m long passenger robot that transforms from a car to a humanoid in 50 seconds. Is it like a Transformer?
summary: 舞台装置や遊戯機械の設計・製造を手掛ける三精テクノロジーズが開発した乗用人型変形ロボット「SR-01」が、スタートアップ向けの展示会「SusHi Tech Tokyo 2026」（東京ビッグサイト、4月27～29日）の未来体験パビリオンに展示された。会場では全長約4.7m、車重2.3tの巨体が、車型から人型に変形するデモを披露した。
summary_en: The SR-01, a passenger humanoid transforming robot developed by Sansei Technologies, which designs and manufactures stage equipment and amusement machines, was exhibited at the Future Experience Pavilion at SusHi Tech Tokyo 2026 (Tokyo Big Sight, April 27-29), an exhibition for startups. At the venue, there was a demonstration of a gigantic vehicle with a total length of approximately 4.7 meters and a weight of 2.3 tons that transformed from a car shape to a humanoid shape.

title: “白髪”はがんから体を守った印？　急な黒髪復活は要注意、頭皮活性化に警鐘──東大などがNature系列で2025年に発表
title_en: Is “white hair” a sign of protection from cancer? Be wary of the sudden return of black hair, warn about scalp revitalization - University of Tokyo and others will announce in 2025 in Nature series
summary: 白髪とがん（メラノーマ、悪性黒色腫）の関係を解き明かした研究が、2025年10月にNature Cell Biologyで発表された。東京大学医科学研究所が主導し、理化学研究所および東京科学大学と共同で実施したもので、論文タイトルは「agonistic stem cell fates under stress govern decisions between hair greying and melanoma」。
summary_en: A study that elucidated the relationship between gray hair and cancer (melanoma, malignant melanoma) was published in Nature Cell Biology in October 2025. The research was led by the Institute of Medical Science, the University of Tokyo, and was conducted jointly with RIKEN and Tokyo University of Science, and the paper is titled ``agonistic stem cell fates under stress govern decisions between hair graying and melanoma.''

title: “腹筋”がポンプとなり脳内のゴミを洗い流す？　腹部収縮による脳内体液の循環システムをマウスで確認、Nature系列で掲載
title_en: Do your “abdominal muscles” act as a pump and wash away the garbage in your brain? Brain fluid circulation system caused by abdominal contractions confirmed in mice, published in Nature series
summary: 米ペンシルベニア州立大学などに所属する研究者らがNature Neuroscienceで発表した「Brain motion is driven by mechanical coupling with the abdomen」は、起きている時の脳の動きは、腹部との力学的なつながりによって引き起こされていることが明らかになった研究報告だ。
summary_en: ``Brain motion is driven by mechanical coupling with the abdomen,'' published in Nature Neuroscience by researchers affiliated with Pennsylvania State University and other institutions in the US, is a research report that reveals that brain movement during waking hours is caused by a mechanical connection with the abdomen.

title: 大気が存在する太陽系外縁天体、国立天文台など発見　冥王星以外では初
title_en: National Astronomical Observatory of Japan discovers extra-solar system celestial bodies with atmosphere; first outside of Pluto
summary: 国立天文台は5日、直径が冥王星の5分の1程度の太陽系外縁天体が、極めて薄い大気を持っていることが分かったと発表した。
summary_en: The National Astronomical Observatory of Japan announced on the 5th that it has been found that a trans-Neptunian object with a diameter of about one-fifth that of Pluto has an extremely thin atmosphere.

title: Google検索のAI機能が進化、Redditなどの「体験談」を回答に集約　リンク配置も改善
title_en: Google search's AI function has evolved, aggregates "experiences" from Reddit etc. into answers, and improves link placement
summary: Googleは、Google検索のAI機能をアップデートした。他者からのアドバイスを求める検索傾向に対応し、SNSやRedditなどの掲示板の意見を回答に集約。発信者情報の表示や、リンク配置の改善、購読メディアへのラベル付けなどの機能を追加し、ユーザーが一次情報や信頼できるソースを素早く探索できるよう支援する狙いとしている。
summary_en: Google has updated the AI ​​functionality of Google Search. In response to the search trend of seeking advice from others, we aggregate opinions from bulletin boards such as SNS and Reddit into answers. It aims to help users quickly find primary information and trusted sources by adding features such as displaying sender information, improved link placement, and labeling of subscribed media.

title: ドローン攻撃受けたAWS中東（UAE）リージョン、復旧には数カ月かかる見込み
title_en: AWS Middle East (UAE) region hit by drone attack, recovery expected to take months
summary: 米Amazon Web Services（AWS）は、米国とイスラエルによるイランへの攻撃に端を発した紛争により深刻な被害を受けた中東（アラブ首長国連邦 UAE）リージョン（ME-CENTRAL-1）の状況を、約2カ月振りに報告しました。
summary_en: For the first time in about two months, Amazon Web Services (AWS) has reported on the situation in the Middle East (UAE) region (ME-CENTRAL-1), which has been severely damaged by the conflict that began with the attack on Iran by the United States and Israel.

title: xAIはSpaceXのAI部門「SpaceXAI」に　イーロン・マスク氏がXで明らかに
title_en: xAI will become SpaceX's AI division "SpaceXAI" Elon Musk reveals on X
summary: イーロン・マスク氏は、xAIを独立した会社として解散し、SpaceXのAI部門「SpaceXAI」へ統合すると発表した。Anthropicにデータセンター「Colossus 1」を利用させる契約の発表も、SpaceXAIが主体になっている。
summary_en: Elon Musk announced that xAI will be dissolved as an independent company and integrated into SpaceX's AI division, SpaceXAI. SpaceXAI is also the main party in announcing the agreement that will allow Anthropic to use its data center, Colossus 1.

title: ソニーセミコンとTSMC、次世代イメージセンサーで提携　フィジカルAI分野に照準
title_en: Sony Semicon and TSMC partner on next-generation image sensors, targeting physical AI field
summary: ソニーはTSMCと次世代イメージセンサーの開発・製造に関する合弁会社設立に向け基本合意した。熊本県に拠点を置き、車載やロボティクスなどのフィジカルAI分野を強化する。一方で、ホームAV事業をTCLとの合弁会社へ承継し、テレビの自社製造から事実上撤退しており、成長分野へ経営資源を集中させる構造改革を加速させる。
summary_en: Sony has reached a basic agreement with TSMC to establish a joint venture to develop and manufacture next-generation image sensors. Based in Kumamoto Prefecture, the company will strengthen its field of physical AI such as in-vehicle and robotics. Meanwhile, the company has transferred its home AV business to a joint venture with TCL, effectively withdrawing from in-house TV manufacturing, and is accelerating structural reforms to concentrate management resources on growth fields.

title: Fitbitアプリは「Google Health」に　Googlがフィットネスアプリ統合　既存ユーザーも順次移行
title_en: Fitbit app becomes "Google Health" Google integrates fitness app Existing users will gradually migrate
summary: 米Googleは5月8日、ヘルスケアアプリ「Fitbit」の名称を「Google Health」へ変更し、全面刷新すると発表。米国時間19日より全ユーザーを対象に順次アップデートを開始する。
summary_en: Google announced on May 8th that it will change the name of its healthcare app "Fitbit" to "Google Health" and completely revamp it. The update will start rolling out to all users starting on the 19th (US time).

title: Apple、390億円の和解金支払いで合意　AI機能の開発遅れに関する集団訴訟で
title_en: Apple agrees to pay 39 billion yen in settlement in class action lawsuit over delayed development of AI functions
summary: 音声アシスタント「Siri」のAI機能の誇大広告を巡る集団訴訟について、米Appleが2億5000万ドル（約390億円）の支払いで合意する和解案を米国の裁判所へ提出した。2024年に発表したAIプラットフォーム「Apple Intelligence」の開発遅れに関するもので、同社は今後、和解の対象となる米国の消費者に対して端末1台につき基本25ドルを支払うとしている。
summary_en: Apple has submitted a settlement proposal to a US court in which it agrees to pay $250 million (approximately 39 billion yen) in a class action lawsuit over the overhyped AI capabilities of its voice assistant Siri. The settlement relates to delays in the development of Apple Intelligence, an AI platform announced in 2024, and the company will now pay eligible U.S. consumers $25 per device.

title: 「Switch 2」値上げへ　1万円アップの5万9980円に

summary_en: Nintendo has announced price revisions for game consoles and related services. In addition to all Switch series models including the new model "Nintendo Switch 2", the subscription service "Nintendo Switch Online" and toys such as playing cards and Hanafuda cards are eligible.

title: ヤフオクも「ちいかわ」ハッピーセット出品一時禁止へ　メルカリに続き
title_en: Yahoo! Auctions also temporarily bans listing of “Chiikawa” Happy Sets, following Mercari
summary: LINEヤフーは8日、日本マクドナルドが15日に販売を始める「ハッピーセット」の「ちいかわ」について、「Yahoo!フリマ」「Yahoo!オークション」への出品を一時的に禁止すると発表した。
summary_en: LINE Yahoo announced on the 8th that it will temporarily prohibit the listing of ``Chikawa,'' a ``Happy Meal'' that McDonald's Japan will start selling on the 15th, on ``Yahoo! Flea Market'' and ``Yahoo! Auction.''

title: メローニ伊首相がAI生成とみられる自身の下着姿投稿　捏造画像通し「危険なツール」と警告
title_en: Italian Prime Minister Meloni posts a fake image of herself in underwear that appears to be AI-generated, warning that it is a "dangerous tool"
summary: イタリアのメローニ首相が、AIの合成で作られたとみられる自身の下着姿の写真を、自らのSNSで公開し、虚偽画像が捏造される危険性について警告した。
summary_en: Italian Prime Minister Meloni posted on his social media a photo of himself in underwear that appears to have been created using AI, warning of the risk of false images being fabricated.

title: はてな、約11億円の資金流出で特別調査委員会を設置　外部の専門家で構成
title_en: Hatena establishes special investigation committee consisting of external experts after capital outflow of approximately 1.1 billion yen
summary: はてなは7日、不正な送金指示によって約11億円の資金が銀行口座から流出した件で、外部の専門家で構成する特別調査委員会を設置すると発表した。
summary_en: Hatena announced on the 7th that it will establish a special investigation committee comprised of outside experts in connection with the leakage of approximately 1.1 billion yen from bank accounts due to fraudulent remittance instructions.

title: 「FILCO」のダイヤテックが破産──東京商工リサーチ
title_en: “FILCO” Diatech goes bankrupt ─ Tokyo Shoko Research
summary: 「FILCO」ブランドのメカニカルキーボードで知られるダイヤテックが東京地裁から破産開始の決定を受けた。東京商工リサーチが5月8日に伝えた。
summary_en: Diatech, known for its FILCO brand mechanical keyboards, has been ordered to enter bankruptcy by the Tokyo District Court. Tokyo Shoko Research reported on May 8th.

title: メルカリ、「ちいかわ」のハッピーセット出品禁止へ
title_en: Mercari to ban "Chiikawa" Happy Set listings
summary: メルカリは5月8日、日本マクドナルドが15日に提供開始するハッピーセットに付属する「ちいかわ」の玩具について、一時的に販売を制限すると発表した。監視を強化し、市販したユーザーには利用制限を課す可能性もある。
summary_en: Mercari announced on May 8th that McDonald's Japan will temporarily restrict sales of the Chikawa toy that comes with the Happy Meal that McDonald's Japan will start offering on the 15th. There is also the possibility that monitoring will be strengthened and usage restrictions may be imposed on users who sell the product.

title: 「イルカいないの？」って言ったヤツちょっと来い　蘇るトラウマ、「Copilot Keyboard」正式リリース
title_en: Come on, the guy who said “Isn’t there a dolphin?” Reliving the trauma, “Copilot Keyboard” officially released
summary: かつて検索窓に「お前を消す方法」と入力したスクリーンショットがネットで大人気となり、ネットミーム化した「カイル」。ヤツが「Copilot Keyboard」正式版で帰ってきたのである。しかもタメ語で。
summary_en: ``Kyle'' once posted a screenshot of him typing ``How to make you disappear'' in the search window, which became very popular on the Internet and became an Internet meme. He's back with the official version of "Copilot Keyboard." And in Tame language.

title: Spotify、AI生成の音声コンテンツを保存できるCLIツール「Save to Spotify」公開
title_en: Spotify releases “Save to Spotify,” a CLI tool that can save AI-generated audio content
summary: Spotifyは、AIエージェントが生成した音声コンテンツをライブラリに保存・再生できる新機能「Save to Spotify」を発表した。CLIツールを利用し、AIによる要約やメモを非公開のポッドキャストとしてライブラリに追加できる。「OpenClaw」「Claude Code」「OpenAI Codex」などと連携し、アップロードやメタデータ付与までを自動で行う機能だ。
summary_en: Spotify has announced a new feature called ``Save to Spotify'' that allows you to save and play audio content generated by AI agents in your library. Using the CLI tool, you can add AI summaries and notes to your library as private podcasts. This function works with "OpenClaw," "Claude Code," "OpenAI Codex," etc., and automatically uploads and adds metadata.

title: IT大喜利「エンタープライズ版BeReal.にありそうなこと」【結果発表】
title_en: IT Ogiri “What is likely to happen in the enterprise version of BeReal.” [Results announced]
summary: 今回のお題は「エンタープライズ版BeReal.にありそうなこと」。本記事では読者の皆さまから集めた回答のうち、担当者が独断と偏見で選んだ名回答を紹介します。
summary_en: This time's topic is "What is likely to happen in the enterprise version of BeReal." In this article, we will introduce the best answers selected by the person in charge based on our own discretion and bias from among the answers collected from readers.

title: 「ChatGPT」に緊急連絡先機能「Trusted Contact」登場　自殺リスク検知で通知
title_en: Emergency contact function “Trusted Contact” introduced in “ChatGPT” Notification when suicide risk is detected
summary: OpenAIは、「ChatGPT」にメンタルヘルスの懸念が生じた際に信頼できる人物へ通知する安全機能「Trusted Contact」を追加した。18歳以上の個人ユーザーが対象で、AIと人間が深刻なリスクを検知した場合にのみユーザーが指定した連絡先へ安否確認を促す。会話の詳細は非公開で、現実のサポートへの橋渡しを目的とする。
summary_en: OpenAI has added a safety feature to ChatGPT called Trusted Contact, which notifies a trusted person when a mental health concern arises. Targeting individual users over the age of 18, the service will only prompt users to contact their designated contacts to confirm their safety if AI and humans detect a serious risk. The details of the conversation will not be made public, and the purpose is to provide a bridge to real-life support.

title: 「脳内のゴミ掃除機能」壊す新たな一因を特定　抗体で狙い撃ち→マウスのアルツハイマー症状が改善
title_en: A new factor that disrupts the "brain's garbage cleaning function" is identified and targeted with antibodies → Alzheimer's symptoms improve in mice
summary: 広州医科大学などに所属する研究者らが発表した論文「A brain-persistent DDR2-degrading antibody reverses Alzheimer’s pathologies by restoring brain fluid dynamics and metabolic clearance」は、アルツハイマー病に伴い脳の老廃物排出システムの崩壊を引き起こす原因タンパク質を特定し、これを分解する抗体を脳内に届けることで病態を改善できることをマウスで示した研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``A brain-persistent DDR2-degrading antibody reverses Alzheimer's pathologies by restoring brain fluid dynamics and metabolic clearance'' published by researchers affiliated with Guangzhou Medical University is a research report showing in mice that the disease condition can be improved by identifying the protein that causes the collapse of the brain's waste excretion system in Alzheimer's disease and delivering antibodies that degrade it into the brain.

title: 脳のオン/オフ切り替えは鍛えられる──イメトレで実際の運動能力向上に成功、慶應大がPNASで発表
title_en: Turning the brain on and off can be trained - Image training successfully improves actual motor skills, Keio University announces on PNAS
summary: 慶應義塾大学に所属する研究者らがPNASで発表した論文「Brain-computer interface-based neurofeedback training enables transferable control of cortical state switching in humans」は、ブレイン・コンピュータ・インタフェース（BCI）を活用し、イメージトレーニング（イメトレ）中の脳状態を可視化することで、実際の運動能力を向上させることに成功した研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``Brain-computer interface-based neuralfeedback training enables transferable control of cortical state switching in humans,'' published by researchers affiliated with Keio University in PNAS, is a research report that successfully improves actual motor performance by visualizing the brain state during image training using a brain-computer interface (BCI).

title: Google、画面がないフィットネストラッカー「Fitbit Air」発表　Geminiが“専任コーチ”に
title_en: Google announces fitness tracker “Fitbit Air” without screen; Gemini becomes “dedicated coach”
summary: 米Googleは5月7日、ウェアラブル「Fitbit」シリーズの新モデル「Google Fitbit Air」を発表した。画面を搭載しないリストバンドタイプのトラッカーで、Fitbitシリーズ最小としている。同日にGoogle ストアで予約受付を開始し、26日に発売する。価格は1万6800円。AndroidだけでなくiOSでも利用可能。
summary_en: On May 7th, Google announced the new model of its wearable Fitbit series, the Google Fitbit Air. It is a wristband-type tracker without a screen, and is the smallest in the Fitbit series. Pre-orders will begin on the Google Store on the same day, and it will be released on the 26th. The price is 16,800 yen. Available not only for Android but also for iOS.

title: 大人向けビデオ通話「Kyuun」などで約4万件のユーザー情報漏えいか　11のアプリも対象
title_en: Approximately 40,000 users' information was leaked through video calls for adults such as "Kyuun," and 11 apps were also affected.
summary: 「Kyuun」を運営するSTARTDASHは、海外からの不正アクセスにより、Kyuunおよび11のスマートフォンアプリで一部ユーザー情報が外部に漏えいした可能性があると公表した。
summary_en: STARTDASH, which operates Kyuun, has announced that some user information on Kyuun and 11 smartphone apps may have been leaked externally due to unauthorized access from overseas.

title: iPS細胞の特許延長、京大申請へ　再生医療等製品の条件付き承認受け
title_en: Patent extension for iPS cells to be submitted to Kyoto University; conditional approval received for regenerative medicine products
summary: 京都大が人工多能性幹細胞（iPS細胞）に関する基本特許の権利延長に向け、6月までに特許庁へ申請する方針を明らかにした。開発初期に出願した基本特許は20年間で原則効力を失うが、iPS細胞を用いた2製品が再生医療等製品として製造販売の条件・期限付き承認を得たことで、最長5年間の延長申請が可能になった。
summary_en: Kyoto University has announced that it will apply to the Japan Patent Office by June to extend its basic patent on induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells). In principle, basic patents applied for in the early stages of development lose their validity after 20 years, but two products using iPS cells have been approved for manufacture and sale as regenerative medicine products with conditions and time limits, making it possible to apply for an extension for up to five years.

title: 「世界サーバ投げ選手権」2026年のチャンピオンはSAP従業員
title_en: "World Server Throwing Championship" 2026 champion will be SAP employee
summary: ドイツで3月25～28日（現地時間）に開催された技術イベント「CloudFest」で、サーバを人力で投げ、その飛距離を競う大会「World Server Throwing Championship 2026」が併催された。女子トーナメントの優勝者は独SAPの従業員というサラ・クレマーさん。男子トーナメントでは米IT機器販売代理店に務めるジョン・エガースさんが優勝した。
summary_en: At the technology event "CloudFest" held in Germany from March 25th to 28th (local time), the "World Server Throwing Championship 2026", a competition in which servers are thrown by hand and players compete to see how far they can throw them, was also held. The winner of the women's tournament was Sara Kremer, an employee of SAP in Germany. The men's tournament was won by John Eggers, who works as an IT equipment distributor in the United States.

title: 「Chromebookは継続」　Googleが10年間のアップデートを改めて約束　「Googlebook」発表を受け
title_en: "Chromebook will continue" Google recommits 10 years of updates following "Googlebook" announcement
summary: 米Googleは5月14日（現地時間）、Chromebookに対する継続的な取り組みと今後の展望を公開した。既存のChromebookに対し、今後10年間にわたる自動アップデートを継続して提供することを強調。あわせて、AI 機能を核とした次世代機「Googlebook」への移行を見据えつつ、組織における安定したデバイス運用を支える方針を示した。
summary_en: On May 14th (local time), Google announced its ongoing efforts and future prospects for Chromebooks. He emphasized that existing Chromebooks will continue to receive automatic updates for the next 10 years. At the same time, the company outlined a policy to support stable device operations in organizations while looking ahead to the transition to the next-generation Googlebook device with AI functionality at its core.

title: 「【機密】昇進リスト先行公開、VPNでアクセスを」巧妙な詐欺メールが拡散中　「給与改定」「交通費改定」版も
title_en: ``[Confidential] Advance release of promotion list, access with VPN'' clever fraudulent email is spreading, ``Salary revision'' and ``Transportation expenses revision'' version also available
summary: 「給与改定」「人事評価および昇進対象者リストの先行公開について」――会社員なら気になる件名の詐欺メールが、5月上旬ごろから出回っている。
summary_en: Fraudulent emails with subjects that would be of concern to office workers have been circulating since early May: ``Salary revision'' and ``Advance publication of personnel evaluation and promotion list.''

title: 「Android 17」に複数の新機能　銀行を装った詐欺電話の自動切断や“10秒待機”でアプリの使いすぎ防止も
title_en: "Android 17" has multiple new features: automatic disconnection of fraudulent calls pretending to be from a bank and "10 second wait" feature to prevent overuse of apps
summary: Googleが5月12日に発表した「Android 17」の新機能では、クリエイター向けの制作支援機能の追加に加え、盗難対策などのセキュリティ面も強化する。
summary_en: The new features of "Android 17" announced by Google on May 12th include the addition of production support functions for creators, as well as enhanced security such as anti-theft measures.

title: 「『妖怪ウォッチ2』Unityで作り直した」非公式リメイク報告、海外で拡散　レベルファイブ「厳正に対処」
title_en: "'Yo-kai Watch 2' remade with Unity" unofficial remake report spread overseas Level 5 "Strictly dealt with"
summary: Xで、「妖怪ウォッチ2」をUnityで再構築し、「PC、モバイル、Switch、VRで利用可能にした」と主張するスペイン語の投稿と、スクリーンショットが公開されていた。
summary_en: On X, a Spanish-language post and screenshots were published claiming that ``Yo-kai Watch 2'' was rebuilt with Unity and ``available on PC, mobile, Switch, and VR.''

title: Instagram、素の日常を共有できる新機能「Instants」リリース　写真は友達の閲覧後に自動消去
title_en: Instagram releases new feature "Instants" that allows you to share your daily life - photos are automatically deleted after being viewed by friends
summary: 米Metaは5月13日、Instagramで日常の瞬間をフィルタなしで友達と共有できる新機能「Instants（インスタント）」を全世界でリリースした。カメラで撮影した写真をそのままシェアし、閲覧後に自動消去する特徴を持つ。同時に、カメラ機能を素早く起動できる独立アプリ「Instants app」のテスト公開も一部の国で開始した。
summary_en: On May 13th, Meta released a new feature worldwide on Instagram called ``Instants'' that allows users to share everyday moments with their friends without filters. It has the feature of sharing photos taken with the camera as they are and automatically deleting them after viewing. At the same time, a test release of the "Instants app", an independent app that can quickly activate camera functions, has begun in some countries.

title: Amazon、ショッピングAI「Rufus」を「Alexa for Shopping」に刷新　「Alexa+」と統合し外部サイト購入にも対応
title_en: Amazon revamps shopping AI "Rufus" to "Alexa for Shopping", integrates with "Alexa+" and supports purchases from external sites
summary: Amazonは、AIショッピングアシスタント「Rufus」を「Alexa for Shopping」へ移行すると発表した。スマートスピーカーで使われる「Alexa+」と機能を統合し、個人の好みや会話履歴を反映した高度な買い物サポートを実現する。外部サイトでの代理購入や価格通知にも対応。まずは米国で全ユーザー向けに無料提供を開始する。
summary_en: Amazon announced that it will migrate its AI shopping assistant "Rufus" to "Alexa for Shopping." It integrates functionality with Alexa+, which is used in smart speakers, to provide advanced shopping support that reflects individual preferences and conversation history. It also supports proxy purchasing and price notifications on external sites. Initially, it will be available for free to all users in the United States.

title: ChatGPTの医療アドバイスで薬を過剰摂取、米国で19歳大学生が死亡　遺族がOpenAI提訴
title_en: 19-year-old college student dies in the US after overdosing on medication due to ChatGPT's medical advice; family files OpenAI lawsuit
summary: ChatGPTによる不適切な医療アドバイスが原因で息子が薬物の過剰摂取で死亡したとして、遺族（母親と継父）が開発元の米OpenAIと同社の最高経営責任者（CEO）であるサム・アルトマン氏をサンフランシスコ郡上級裁判所に提訴した。遺族の代理人らが5月12日に発表した。
summary_en: The family of OpenAI (mother and stepfather) is suing developer OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman in San Francisco County Superior Court, alleging that their son died of a drug overdose due to inappropriate medical advice provided by ChatGPT. The family's representatives made the announcement on May 12th.

title: くら寿司、万博店を再現した“メモリアル店“オープン　回転ベルトなど移設、世界70カ国の料理も
title_en: Kura Sushi opens a “memorial store” that recreates the Expo store. Rotating belts have been relocated, and dishes from 70 countries around the world are also available.
summary: くら寿司は14日、「大阪・関西万博」で注目を集めた「くら寿司 万博店」のコンセプトを引き継ぐ「くら寿司　メモリアル店　なんば千日前」をオープンした。
summary_en: On the 14th, Kura Sushi opened ``Kura Sushi Memorial Store Namba Sennichimae,'' which inherits the concept of the ``Kura Sushi Expo Store,'' which attracted attention at the ``Osaka Kansai Expo.''

title: 高市首相、“研究費実質倍増”を表明　産総研拡充も　「新技術立国」へ
title_en: Prime Minister Takaichi announces “effective doubling of research funding” and expansion of AIST to become a “new technology nation”
summary: 「強い経済の基盤は、優れた科学技術力」とし、官民で連携して競争力強化に取り組む。
summary_en: Recognizing that "the foundation of a strong economy is superior science and technology," the public and private sectors will work together to strengthen competitiveness.

title: iPS医療製品、年内にも実用化　アムシェプリ開発の住友ファーマが挑むコスト回収の壁
title_en: iPS medical products will be commercialized within the year; cost recovery challenges faced by Sumitomo Pharma, developer of Amshepri
summary: 世界初の人工多能性幹細胞（iPS細胞）由来の再生医療等製品「アムシェプリ」が、20日から公的医療保険の対象となる。山中伸弥京都大教授が2006年にマウスのiPS細胞作製を報告して約20年。アムシェプリの製造販売は条件・期限付きで認められた「仮免許」の段階にあり、販売開始後は、期限内に有効性を示すデータを収集し開発コストを回収できるかが焦点になる。
summary_en: Amshepri, the world's first regenerative medicine product derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells), will be covered by public medical insurance from the 20th. It has been about 20 years since Kyoto University Professor Shinya Yamanaka reported on the production of mouse iPS cells in 2006. The manufacture and sale of Amshepri is currently under a ``provisional license'' with certain conditions and a limited time limit, and once sales begin, the focus will be on whether the company can collect data showing its effectiveness and recover development costs within the time limit.

title: AIブームでクラウドインフラ市場が年35％の急成長　上位3社のシェアには変動なし　2026年第1四半期、Synergy Research調査
title_en: The cloud infrastructure market is rapidly growing at 35% per year due to the AI ​​boom, the shares of the top 3 companies remain unchanged, 1st quarter of 2026, Synergy Research survey
summary: 調査会社の米Synergy Research Groupは、グローバルにおける2026年第1四半期のクラウドインフラの市場状況について調査結果を発表しました。
summary_en: American research company Synergy Research Group has announced the results of a survey regarding the global cloud infrastructure market situation in the first quarter of 2026.

title: リコージャパン、社内基幹システムに障害　通信回線破損で　「サイバー攻撃ではない」
title_en: Ricoh Japan's internal core system fails due to broken communication line, ``not a cyber attack''
summary: 主要業務システムが利用できない状態に。商品の納期が遅延している。
summary_en: Main business systems become unavailable. The delivery of the product is delayed.

title: AI防衛技術のAndurilが50億ドル調達　トランプ政権下の軍近代化加速
title_en: AI defense technology Anduril raises $5 billion to accelerate military modernization under Trump administration
summary: パルマー・ラッキー氏創業のAI防衛技術企業Anduril Industriesは、50億ドルの資金調達を実施し、企業評価額が610億ドルに達した。トランプ政権による軍の近代化を背景に、AIや自律技術を融合させた防衛システムの製造能力拡大と研究開発を加速させる。
summary_en: Anduril Industries, an AI defense technology company founded by Palmer Lackey, has raised $5 billion in funding, reaching a valuation of $61 billion. Against the backdrop of the Trump administration's military modernization, we will expand manufacturing capacity and accelerate research and development of defense systems that combine AI and autonomous technology.

title: “人型ロボ完全国産化”目指すベンチャーから身長約130cmの小型モデル　中国機ベースも、近く国産化ロードマップ発表
title_en: A small model with a height of approximately 130 cm from a venture aiming to “fully domestically produce humanoid robots” based on Chinese machines will soon announce a roadmap for domestic production
summary: 国産ヒューマノイドロボット開発を目指すドーナッツロボティクス（東京都港区）が、東京ビッグサイトで開催されたスタートアップ展示会「SusHi Tech Tokyo 2026」で新型機「cinnamon mini」（シナモン ミニ）を初公開した。現時点では中国製ロボットがベースだが、近く同社製ヒューマノイドロボットの国産化に向けた具体的なロードマップを示す方針も明らかにした。
summary_en: Donut Robotics (Minato-ku, Tokyo), which aims to develop domestically produced humanoid robots, unveiled its new model ``cinnamon mini'' for the first time at the startup exhibition ``SusHi Tech Tokyo 2026'' held at Tokyo Big Sight. At present, the company's robots are based on Chinese-made robots, but the company has also announced plans to lay out a concrete roadmap for domestic production of its humanoid robots in the near future.

title: コーヒーは腸を介して認知機能に影響する？　アイルランドでの調査結果、Nature系列誌で研究発表
title_en: Does coffee affect cognitive function through the intestines?　Research results in Ireland published in Nature series journal
summary: アイルランドのユニバーシティ・カレッジ・コークやイタリアのパルマ大学に所属する研究者らがNature Communicationsで発表した論文「Habitual coffee intake shapes the gut microbiome and modifies host physiology and cognition」は、日常的に飲むコーヒーが、腸内細菌叢（マイクロバイオーム）や人間の生理機能、認知能力にどのような影響を与えるかを調査した研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper, ``Habitual coffee intake shapes the gut microbiome and modifies host physiology and cognition,'' published in Nature Communications by researchers from University College Cork in Ireland and the University of Parma in Italy, investigates the effects of daily coffee consumption on the intestinal flora (microbiome), human physiology, and cognitive ability.

title: 米中首脳会談の代表団にイーロン・マスク氏、ジェンスン・フアン氏、ティム・クック氏など17人の企業幹部が参加
title_en: 17 business executives, including Elon Musk, Jensen Huang and Tim Cook, will be part of the US-China summit delegation
summary: トランプ米大統領は、習近平国家主席との首脳会談に向けた訪中に、イーロン・マスク氏やジェンスン・フアン氏、ティム・クック氏ら17人の企業幹部を同行させた。中国との間で投資委員会や貿易委員会の設立について協議する見通しだ。
summary_en: US President Trump was accompanied by 17 business executives, including Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, and Tim Cook, on his trip to China for a summit meeting with President Xi Jinping. It is expected that there will be discussions with China regarding the establishment of an investment commission and a trade commission.

title: ソニー、6680万画素のフルサイズミラーレス「α7R VI」発表　R初の積層型センサー　約74万円
title_en: Sony announces 66.8 million pixel full-frame mirrorless "α7R VI" R's first stacked sensor approximately 740,000 yen
summary: ソニーは5月13日、フルサイズミラーレス一眼カメラ「α7R VI」を発表した。αシリーズ最高となる有効6680万画素の積層型CMOSイメージセンサーを搭載し、ブラックアウトフリーで最高約30コマ/秒の連続撮影に対応する。8K 30p動画記録にも対応。6月5日に発売し、市場推定価格は74万円前後。
summary_en: On May 13th, Sony announced the α7R VI full-frame mirrorless single-lens camera. Equipped with a stacked CMOS image sensor with an effective 66.8 million pixels, the highest in the α series, it supports continuous shooting at up to approximately 30 frames per second without blackout. Also supports 8K 30p video recording. It will be released on June 5th, and the estimated market price is around 740,000 yen.

title: キヤノン、動画特化の新フルサイズ「EOS R6 V」投入　“ワンオペ撮影”も強力サポート　約36万円
title_en: Canon launches new full-frame “EOS R6 V” specializing in video, strongly supports “one-operation shooting”, approximately 360,000 yen
summary: キヤノン（東京都大田区）は2026年5月13日、動画クリエイター向けのフルサイズミラーレスカメラ「EOS R6 V」と、パワーズーム機構を内蔵した標準ズームレンズ「RF20-50mm F4 L IS USM PZ」などを発表。発売は26年6月下旬を予定している。
summary_en: On May 13, 2026, Canon (Ota-ku, Tokyo) announced the EOS R6 V, a full-frame mirrorless camera for video creators, and the RF20-50mm F4 L IS USM PZ, a standard zoom lens with a built-in power zoom mechanism. Release is scheduled for late June 2026.

title: DeNAアカウント、メールの乗っ取りに注意喚起　登録情報の書き替えやDeNA Payで金銭被害のおそれも
title_en: Beware of hijacking of DeNA accounts and emails; risk of financial damage due to rewriting of registered information and DeNA Pay
summary: ディー・エヌ・エーは12日、「DeNAアカウント」利用者の一部メールアドレスについて、第三者による乗っ取りや不正ログインが複数発生しているとして注意喚起した。
summary_en: DeNA issued a warning on the 12th, stating that some email addresses of DeNA Account users have been hijacked by third parties and multiple unauthorized logins have occurred.

title: Geminiがスマホを“自動操縦”　Google、Android向けAIエージェント「Gemini Intelligence」発表
title_en: Gemini puts your smartphone on “autopilot” Google announces “Gemini Intelligence” AI agent for Android
summary: Googleは5月12日、Androidの最新情報を紹介するイベント「The Android Show: I/O Edition」において、複数のスマートフォンアプリを横断してタスクを処理するAIエージェント「Gemini Intelligence」を公表した。
summary_en: On May 12th, at the event ``The Android Show: I/O Edition,'' which introduces the latest information on Android, Google announced ``Gemini Intelligence,'' an AI agent that processes tasks across multiple smartphone apps.

title: Claudeに法律業務特化の拡張機能　DocuSignなどと連携、12種の新プラグインも
title_en: Extension function specialized for legal services for Claude - Collaboration with DocuSign etc., 12 new plug-ins included
summary: 米Anthropicは5月12日（現地時間）、AI アシスタント「Claude」において、法律業界で使用されているソフトウェアとClaudeを連携させる20種類以上の新しいMCPコネクタと、特定の法律業務や専門分野に特化した12種類の新しいプラグインをリリースすると発表した。
summary_en: Anthropic announced on May 12 (local time) that it will be releasing more than 20 new MCP connectors for its AI assistant Claude, which will connect Claude with software used in the legal industry, as well as 12 new plug-ins focused on specific legal tasks and areas of expertise.

title: 西友とトライアル、モノクロのカルビー商品が店頭に並ぶ画像に注意喚起　「現時点で販売の事実なし」
title_en: Seiyu and Trial issue warns of images of monochrome Calbee products lined up in stores: ``There is no evidence of sales at this time.''
summary: 西友とトライアルは13日、カルビーポテトチップスのモノクロパッケージ商品が店内で販売されているかのような画像が出回っているとして注意喚起した。
summary_en: Seiyu and Trial Co., Ltd. issued a warning on the 13th, saying that an image of Calbee potato chips in monochrome packaging appears to be being sold in stores.

title: パナソニック、高性能コンデジ「DC-L10」発表　GH7と同じ4/3センサー搭載　21万円前後
title_en: Panasonic announces high-performance compact digital camera “DC-L10” Equipped with 4/3 sensor same as GH7 Approximately 210,000 yen
summary: パナソニックは、レンズ一体型カメラ「LUMIX DC-L10」を発表した。6月中旬発売で、18日午前10時から予約を開始する。「LUMIX GH7」と同じ4/3型BSI CMOSセンサーとLEICA DC VARIO-SUMMILUX 24-75mm F1.7-2.8レンズを搭載する。LUMIX25周年記念のチタンゴールドも限定で用意する。
summary_en: Panasonic has announced the LUMIX DC-L10, a camera with an integrated lens. It will go on sale in mid-June, and pre-orders will begin at 10 a.m. on the 18th. It is equipped with the same 4/3 type BSI CMOS sensor as "LUMIX GH7" and LEICA DC VARIO-SUMMILUX 24-75mm F1.7-2.8 lens. A limited edition titanium gold commemorating the 25th anniversary of LUMIX will also be available.

title: Google、AI特化の次世代ノートPC「Googlebook」発表　26年後半に投入へ
title_en: Google announces AI-specific next-generation notebook PC “Googlebook” to be launched in the second half of 2026
summary: 米Googleは5月12日（現地時間）、生成AI「Gemini」の利用を前提に設計した新型ノートパソコン「Googlebook」を発表した。ChromeOSとAndroidの技術を統合し、AIによるサポート機能「Gemini Intelligence」を核に据える。
summary_en: On May 12th (local time), Google announced a new laptop computer, ``Googlebook'', designed to use the generative AI ``Gemini''. It integrates ChromeOS and Android technology, with AI support function "Gemini Intelligence" at its core.

title: 撮影時にAIがレンズやボケ表現を提案するスマホ　ソニー「Xperia 1 VIII」発売
title_en: Sony releases “Xperia 1 VIII”, a smartphone that uses AI to suggest lenses and bokeh expressions when shooting
summary: ソニーは13日、新機能「AIカメラアシスタント」を搭載したフラグシップスマートフォン「Xperia 1 VIII」を発表した。SIMフリーモデルは23万6000円前後から。
summary_en: On the 13th, Sony announced the flagship smartphone "Xperia 1 VIII" equipped with a new function "AI Camera Assistant". SIM-free models start at around 236,000 yen.

title: 自民党、生成AIを悪用したディープフェイク広告に対策案　罰則含めた法整備求める
title_en: Liberal Democratic Party calls for legislation to include measures and penalties for deepfake ads that misuse generated AI
summary: 自民党は5月12日、生成AIで本物と見分けがつかないほど精巧な偽物コンテンツを作成する「ディープフェイク」を悪用したSNS型投資詐欺への対策案をまとめた。
summary_en: On May 12, the Liberal Democratic Party compiled a plan to counter social media investment scams that exploit ``deepfakes,'' which use generated AI to create fake content so sophisticated that it is indistinguishable from the real thing.

title: Claude Mythosがもたらすセキュリティビジネス激変の可能性　二極化していく“業界のこれから”
title_en: The possibility of drastic changes in the security business brought about by Claude Mythos - the polarizing future of the industry
summary: IT業界の話題をさらう、Anthropicのセキュリティ特化型エージェント「Claude Mythos」。MythosのようなAIスキャナーの普及がセキュリティ業界の構造にどんな変化をもたらすのか。IT組織作りに携わってきた筆者が視点から分析する。
summary_en: Anthropic's security-specific agent "Claude Mythos" has become a hot topic in the IT industry. What changes will the spread of AI scanners like Mythos bring to the structure of the security industry? The author, who has been involved in building IT organizations, will analyze this from his perspective.

title: TikTok動画から旅行予約「TikTok GO」日本で利用拡大　半年で270％増
title_en: Use of ``TikTok GO'', a travel booking service based on TikTok videos, is expanding in Japan - 270% increase in six months
summary: 海外ユーザーによる日本旅行・体験の予約売上も直近3カ月間で大幅に伸びたとし、成長をアピールしている。
summary_en: Sales of reservations for travel and experiences in Japan by overseas users have also increased significantly over the past three months, highlighting the company's growth.

title: マツダ、電動化投資を3000億円減額　需要縮小で自社開発EV投入を2年程度延期
title_en: Mazda reduces electrification investment by 300 billion yen, postpones launch of self-developed EV by about 2 years due to shrinking demand
summary: マツダが電動化投資計画の修正を発表した。昨年3月時点で1.5兆円としていた2022～30年の累計投資額を1.2兆円に3000億円減額する。トランプ政権による環境規制の緩和などに伴う米国の電気自動車（EV）需要の縮小を踏まえ、自社開発EVの投入時期を当初予定の27年から2年程度延期するなど商品戦略を見直した。
summary_en: Mazda has announced revisions to its electrification investment plan. The cumulative investment amount from 2022 to 2030, which was set at 1.5 trillion yen as of March last year, will be reduced by 300 billion yen to 1.2 trillion yen. In light of the shrinking demand for electric vehicles (EVs) in the United States due to the relaxation of environmental regulations by the Trump administration, the company has revised its product strategy, including postponing the launch of its in-house developed EV by about two years from the originally planned 2027.

title: “酒を飲むと顔が赤くなる”体質は収入を左右する？　日本男性含む3000人を調査　東大などが2023年に学術誌で発表
title_en: Does your constitution that “your face turns red when you drink alcohol” affect your income? Survey of 3,000 people, including Japanese men, published by the University of Tokyo in an academic journal in 2023
summary: 東京大学、一橋大学、ソウル国立大学、国立台湾大学に所属する研究者らが2023年にHealth Economicsで発表した論文「Is Asian flushing syndrome a disadvantage in the labor market?」（プレスリリース）は、アルコール耐性の有無が収入や労働時間といった労働市場における成果に影響を与えるかを調査した研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``Is Asian flushing syndrome a disadvantage in the labor market?'' (press release), published in Health Economics in 2023 by researchers affiliated with the University of Tokyo, Hitotsubashi University, Seoul National University, and National Taiwan University, is a research report that investigated whether the presence or absence of alcohol tolerance affects labor market outcomes such as income and working hours.

title: 「ラブライブ！」アクア公式ファンクラブのドメイン、第三者が購入できる状態に→入札額950億円？　ファンから悪用を懸念する声も
title_en: "Love Live!" Aqua official fan club domain available for purchase by third party → Bid amount: 95 billion yen? Some fans voice concerns about abuse.

summary_en: It has been revealed that the domain used by the official fan club of "Aqours" from "Love Live! Sunshine!!" is being auctioned. There are voices on social media pointing out the risk of the product falling into the hands of a third party.

summary: ディー・エヌ・エー（東京都渋谷区）は5月12日、代表取締役の役割変更を内定したと発表。創業者で代表取締役会長の南場智子氏が代表取締役社長兼最高経営責任者（CEO）に復帰し、現社長の岡村信悟氏は代表取締役会長に就く。
summary_en: DeNA (Shibuya-ku, Tokyo) announced on May 12 that it has decided to change the role of representative director. Tomoko Namba, founder and representative director and chairman, will return to the position of representative director, president and chief executive officer (CEO), and current president Shingo Okamura will become representative director and chairman.

summary: アイリスオーヤマが、農業に本格参入しコメの生産に乗り出すと発表した。農地を借り受け、グループの従業員が担い手となる。収穫したコメは自社で精米し、パックご飯に加工して販売する。
summary_en: Iris Ohyama announced that it will make a full-scale entry into agriculture and begin producing rice. The farmland will be leased and the group's employees will be responsible for the project. The harvested rice is polished in-house, processed into packaged rice, and sold.
