summary: 企業ロボット開発企業の中国Unitree Robotics（浙江省杭州市）は、人間が直接乗り込んで操縦できる変形ロボット「GD01」のデモ動画を公開した。
summary_en: Unitree Robotics (Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province), a corporate robot development company in China, has released a demo video of ``GD01,'' a transformable robot that humans can directly board and control.

title: 「イオン大宮」の土地に10万円から投資　三井物産子会社、日本初の“底地”デジタル証券を公開
title_en: Invest in land at Aeon Omiya from 100,000 yen; Mitsui & Co. subsidiary releases Japan's first "land" digital securities
summary: 三井物産デジタル・アセットマネジメント（東京都中央区）は5月12日、デジタル証券（ST）を活用した資産運用サービス「ALTERNA（オルタナ）」において、大型商業施設「イオン大宮」の土地を投資対象とする新商品を公開した。借地権付きの土地所有権、いわゆる「底地（そこち）」をデジタル証券化する試みは国内初という。
summary_en: On May 12, Mitsui & Co. Digital Asset Management (Chuo-ku, Tokyo) unveiled a new product in its asset management service "ALTERNA" that utilizes digital securities (ST) that invests in the land of the large-scale commercial facility "Aeon Omiya." This is said to be the first attempt in Japan to digitally securitize land ownership with leasehold rights, so-called "land with leasehold interest."

title: KDDI、コインチェックと業務提携　約102億円出資　新会社も設立
title_en: KDDI and Coincheck enter into business alliance, invest approximately 10.2 billion yen, and establish new company
summary: KDDIは5月12日、暗号資産取引所「Coincheck」のコインチェックを傘下に持つ、オランダCoincheck Group N.V.（CCG）に資本参画すると発表した。約102億円を出資し、CCGの発行済普通株式の14.9％を取得。ノンカストディアルウォレットなどを扱う新会社も立ち上げる。
summary_en: On May 12, KDDI announced that it will take an equity stake in Coincheck Group N.V. (CCG), the Netherlands, which owns Coincheck, a cryptocurrency exchange. The company invested approximately 10.2 billion yen and acquired 14.9% of CCG's outstanding common stock. A new company that handles non-custodial wallets will also be launched.

title: カルビー、14商品のモノクロパッケージ化を正式発表　「当面の対応策」として25日から　ナフサ不足の影響か

summary_en: Calbee officially announced on the 12th that it will change the packaging of some of its products to two colors, citing instability in the procurement of raw materials due to the increasingly tense situation in the Middle East.

title: ちょっとしたアイデアをAIで長文記事にして公開するのをやめろ

summary:
「AIで記事を書いた」こと自体を問題にしたいわけではない。問題は、ちょっとした思いつき、数行で済む観察、まだ検証していない仮説を、生成AIで数千字の“記事っぽいもの”に膨らませ、そのまま公開する態度にある。
本質的に言いたいことは少ない。たとえば「この設計は保守しづらい」「このサービスの料金体系は不透明だ」「この映画のこの場面が気になった」。それ自体はよい。短いメモとして価値がある場合もある。しかし、そこにAIで「背景」「歴史」「メリット・デメリット」「今後の展望」「まとめ」を機械的に足していくと、重要な一文の周囲に、自明な説明、関係の薄い一般論、薄い比喩、誰にも届かない結論が堆積する。...
summary_en:
I don't want to take issue with the fact that the article was written by AI. The problem lies in the attitude of taking a simple idea, an observation that only takes a few lines, or a hypothesis that has not yet been verified, and using generative AI to expand it into an ``article-like article'' of several thousand characters, and then publishing it as is.
There really isn't much I want to say. For example, ``This design is difficult to maintain,'' ``The fee structure for this service is not transparent,'' and ``This scene in this movie caught my attention.'' That in itself is good. Sometimes it is valuable as a short note. However, if AI automatically adds "background", "history", "advantages/disadvantages", "future prospects", and "summary" to that, obvious explanations, unrelated generalizations, thin metaphors, and conclusions that no one can reach will accumulate around an important sentence. ...

title: Google検索が「AI検索」に──エージェント機能やマルチモーダル入力に対応
title_en: Google search becomes “AI search” ─ Supports agent function and multimodal input
summary: Googleは開発者会議「Google I/O 2026」で、Google検索を複数のGeminiモデルとエージェント機能を統合した「AI検索」へ刷新すると発表した。25年ぶりとなる検索ボックスの刷新でマルチモーダル入力に対応し、AIモードには最新の「Gemini 3.5」を搭載。さらに、Web等を自動監視する「Search Agents」や、検索結果上に連携ミニアプリを自動構築する機能が今夏以降に順次導入される。
summary_en: Google announced at its developer conference ``Google I/O 2026'' that it will revamp Google Search to ``AI Search,'' which integrates multiple Gemini models and agent functions. The search box has been redesigned for the first time in 25 years to support multimodal input, and the AI ​​mode is equipped with the latest "Gemini 3.5". Furthermore, "Search Agents" that automatically monitors the Web, etc., and a function that automatically builds linked mini-apps on search results will be gradually introduced from this summer onwards.

title: Appleが5年がかりで開発したセキュリティ対策を5日で突破　「Mythos」が見せつけた脆弱性攻撃の威力
title_en: Apple overcame security measures that took 5 years to develop in 5 days; Mythos showed off the power of vulnerability attack
summary: 米セキュリティ企業のCalifが、米Appleが5年がかりで開発した最先端のセキュリティ対策「MIE」を突破するエクスプロイト（攻撃プログラム）を、わずか5日間で開発したと発表した。利用したのはAnthropicのAIモデル「Mythos」のプレビュー版だった。
summary_en: US security company Calif has announced that it has developed an exploit (attack program) in just five days that can defeat Apple's most advanced security measure, MIE, which took five years to develop. They used a preview version of Anthropic's AI model, Mythos.

title: 現実世界を基に"動き回れる"仮想空間を生成　Googleの世界生成AI「Project Genie」にストリートビュー連携機能
title_en: Generates a virtual space that you can move around in based on the real world Street View linkage function with Google's world generation AI "Project Genie"
summary: 米Googleは5月19日（現地時間）、汎用ワールドモデル「Project Genie」にストリートビューの位置情報機能を追加した。実在の場所の画像をベースに、AIが創造的な世界を生成できる新機能。Google AI Ultra（月額200ドル）の加入者向けにグローバル展開を開始する。
summary_en: On May 19th (local time), Google added the Street View location information function to its general-purpose world model "Project Genie." A new feature that allows AI to generate creative worlds based on images of real places. Global rollout begins for Google AI Ultra ($200 per month) subscribers.

title: Google、AIグラス発売へ　オーディオグラスは26年秋、ディスプレイ内蔵タイプも投入予定
title_en: Google to release AI glasses; audio glasses with built-in display scheduled to be released in fall 2026
summary: GoogleがAndroid XRプラットフォームに対応したAIスマートグラス「Intelligent eyeware」を発売すると発表した。Geminiと連携するオーディオグラスと、視界に情報を映し出すディスプレイグラスの2種類で、まずはオーディオグラスを26年秋に先行発売する。
summary_en: Google announced that it will release AI smart glasses "Intelligent eyeware" compatible with the Android XR platform. Audio glasses will be released in advance in the fall of 2026, with two types: audio glasses that work with Gemini and display glasses that project information into your field of vision.

title: Google、“動画版Nano Banana”こと「Gemini Omni」公開　会話で映像を生成・編集
title_en: Google releases “Gemini Omni,” also known as “video version of Nano Banana,” generates and edits videos through conversations
summary: 米Googleが開発者会議「Google I/O 2026」で、動画の生成・編集に対応するAIモデル「Gemini Omni」を発表した。自然言語による指示で動画を作成・編集でき、同社は「世界モデル」や画像生成モデル「Nano Banana」の動画版とうたう。最初のモデル「Gemini Omni Flash」の提供も開始した。
summary_en: Google announced at its developer conference "Google I/O 2026" an AI model "Gemini Omni" that supports video generation and editing. You can create and edit videos using natural language instructions, and the company touts it as a video version of the "world model" and image generation model "Nano Banana." We have also started offering our first model, Gemini Omni Flash.

title: 日立、Anthropicと提携　グループ29万人に「Claude」などAI導入　社会インフラ分野にも展開へ
title_en: Hitachi partners with Anthropic to introduce AI such as "Claude" to 290,000 group members, expanding into social infrastructure field
summary: 日立製作所と米Anthropicが戦略的パートナーシップを締結した。Anthropicの生成AIサービス「Claude」など先進AIを日立グループ約29万人の全ビジネスプロセスに導入するほか、同社の社会インフラ向けソリューション群「HMAX by Hitachi」（HMAX）にも展開する。Anthropicを巡っては、4月にNECとの協業を発表。国内ITとの提携を進めている。
summary_en: Hitachi, Ltd. and Anthropic of the US have entered into a strategic partnership. In addition to introducing advanced AI such as Anthropic's generative AI service "Claude" into all business processes of Hitachi Group's approximately 290,000 people, it will also be deployed in the company's social infrastructure solution group "HMAX by Hitachi" (HMAX). Regarding Anthropic, we announced a collaboration with NEC in April. We are proceeding with alliances with domestic IT companies.

title: ドコモはとばっちり？　19日の通信障害、原因はMVNOの設備不具合　DTIも報告
title_en: Is Docomo perfect? The communication failure on the 19th was caused by a malfunction in the MVNO equipment. DTI also reported
summary: NTTドコモは19日、同日朝からSNSなどで話題になっていた携帯電話サービスの障害について、一部MVNOの設備不具合が原因だったと発表した。これとほぼ同時刻にDTIも障害復旧を報告していた。
summary_en: On the 19th, NTT Docomo announced that the problem with its mobile phone service, which had been a hot topic on social media since the morning of the same day, was caused by a malfunction in some of the MVNO's equipment. Around the same time, DTI also reported that the failure had been restored.

title: Metaの“AIメガネ”が日本上陸　「Ray-ban Meta」7万3700円から　手ぶらでカメラ撮影やAIに質問も
title_en: Meta's "AI glasses" have arrived in Japan "Ray-ban Meta" starting from 73,700 yen You can take pictures with the camera and ask questions to the AI ​​without bringing anything
summary: Facebook Japanと仏エシロール・ルックスオティカは、すでに米国と欧州で販売しているメガネ型のAIデバイス「Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2)」および「Oakley Meta」を21日から日本国内で発売する。
summary_en: Facebook Japan and France's Essilor Luxottica will launch in Japan from the 21st the glasses-shaped AI devices ``Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2)'' and ``Oakley Meta,'' which are already sold in the United States and Europe.

title: 「ぶいすぽっ！」運営のBrave group、SBIと戦略的提携を協議　資本参加も視野に
title_en: “Buispop!” operator Brave group discusses strategic alliance with SBI, with capital participation in mind
summary: VTuber「ぶいすぽっ！」などを手掛けるBrave groupが、SBIホールディングスと戦略的提携に向けた協議を始めた。VTuber・eスポーツ領域での連携を軸に分科会を設置し、SBIグループによる資本参加も視野に入れる。
summary_en: Brave group, which handles VTuber "Buispo!" and others, has begun discussions with SBI Holdings for a strategic alliance. A subcommittee will be established to focus on collaboration in the VTuber/esports field, and capital participation by the SBI Group will also be considered.

title: 「ミニ冷蔵庫も運べる」──Boston Dynamics、ヒト型ロボット「Atlas」の最新動画を公開　強化学習で重労働に対応へ
title_en: “It can even carry a mini-fridge” ─ Boston Dynamics releases the latest video of the humanoid robot “Atlas”, which uses reinforcement learning to handle heavy labor
summary: 米Boston Dynamicsは5月19日（現地時間）、人型ロボット「Atlas」が全身を使って小型冷蔵庫を持ち上げ、運搬する最新のテスト動画を公開した。強化学習と高精度なシミュレーション環境を組み合わせることで、荷物の重量変化や偏りといった不確実性にも柔軟に適応した。
summary_en: On May 19th (local time), Boston Dynamics released the latest test video of its humanoid robot ``Atlas'' using its entire body to lift and transport a small refrigerator. By combining reinforcement learning and a highly accurate simulation environment, the system flexibly adapted to uncertainties such as changes in baggage weight and imbalance.

title: 大規模災害時の電源確保でモバイルバッテリー7社と通信8社が連携協定　避難所などへの機材提供を迅速化
title_en: Seven mobile battery companies and eight telecommunications companies agree to collaborate to secure power supply during large-scale disasters, speeding up the provision of equipment to evacuation centers, etc.
summary: モバイルバッテリーメーカーと通信事業者が大規模災害発生時における被災地への電源確保に関する連携協定を締結した。メーカーが調達した機材を通信事業者の拠点に集め、避難所などへ効率的に届ける。
summary_en: A mobile battery manufacturer and a telecommunications carrier have signed a partnership agreement to ensure power supply to disaster-stricken areas in the event of a large-scale disaster. The equipment procured by manufacturers will be collected at carrier bases and efficiently delivered to evacuation centers and other locations.

title: メルカリ、成分表示が確認できないリキッド一体型喫煙具を出品禁止　ニコチン入り電子タバコ念頭か
title_en: Mercari bans listing of liquid-integrated smoking devices whose ingredients can't be confirmed; nicotine-containing e-cigarettes in mind?
summary: メルカリは15日、日本語の成分表示や国内販売元の記載を確認できないリキッド一体型の喫煙具を出品禁止と削除の対象にすると発表した。
summary_en: Mercari announced on the 15th that it will ban or remove any liquid-integrated smoking devices that cannot confirm the ingredients in Japanese or the name of the domestic distributor.

title: 自分や友達の“顔”をゲームにしてしまうスマホアプリ「ピクトニコ！」、任天堂が28日配信開始
title_en: Nintendo starts distributing “Pictonico!”, a smartphone app that turns your and your friends’ faces into a game, on the 28th
summary: 任天堂は19日、顔写真を使ってミニゲームを遊べるスマートフォン向けアプリ「Pictonico!」を28日から配信すると発表した。
summary_en: Nintendo announced on the 19th that it will release Pictonico!, a smartphone app that lets you play mini-games using your face photo, starting on the 28th.

title: 原子力規制庁、2025年度に業務用スマホ10台紛失　2台は未発見「原発や核情報含まず」
title_en: Nuclear Regulation Authority, 10 business smartphones lost in 2025, 2 not found "Does not contain nuclear power plants or nuclear information"
summary: 原子力規制庁は2025年度の1年間に、職員に貸与している業務用スマートフォンの紛失事案が計10件あり、うち2台がいまも見つかっていないことを明らかにした。同庁緊急事案対策室が取材に応じた。
summary_en: The Nuclear Regulation Authority revealed that in the fiscal year 2025, there were a total of 10 cases in which business smartphones lent to employees were lost, and two of these have still not been found. The agency's emergency response office responded to the interview.

title: 「WWDC26」は6月9日午前2時（日本時間）から　Appleがスケジュール公開　新OSなど披露か
title_en: "WWDC26" will be held from 2:00 a.m. on June 9th (Japan time) Apple releases schedule, will show off new OS etc.
summary: 米Appleは5月18日（現地時間）、毎年恒例の年次開発者会議「WWDC26」の詳細スケジュールを発表した。初日の6月8日午前10時（日本時間6月9日午前2時）から行われる基調講演を皮切りに、AI関連における進化や新しいソフトウェア、デベロッパーツールなどの最新アップデートを披露する。
summary_en: On May 18th (local time), Apple announced the detailed schedule for its annual developer conference "WWDC26." Starting with a keynote speech on the first day, June 8th at 10:00 am (June 9th, 2:00 am Japan time), the latest updates on AI-related advances, new software, developer tools, etc. will be unveiled.

title: 転用を断念したEVバス100台超　大阪メトロが「墓場」からの移動開始　移送先は非公表
title_en: Osaka Metro begins moving more than 100 EV buses from the "graveyard", destination not disclosed
summary: 2025年の大阪・関西万博でトラブルが相次いだEVモーターズ・ジャパン（EV社、北九州市）の電気自動車（EV）バスについて、大阪メトロは5月18日、保管している大阪市城東区の同社敷地からトラックで移送を始めたと明らかにした。台数は100台を超えるが、移送先は「明らかにできない」としている。
summary_en: On May 18, Osaka Metro announced that it has begun transporting electric vehicle (EV) buses manufactured by EV Motors Japan (EV Co., Kitakyushu City) by truck from the company's premises in Joto Ward, Osaka City, where they are being stored, after a series of troubles occurred during the 2025 Osaka/Kansai Expo. The number of vehicles exceeds 100, but it is not possible to reveal where they will be transferred.

title: 予防接種手続きデジタル化　6月スタートへ公式ページ開設　スマホで予診票入力でき、管理効率化
title_en: Digitization of vaccination procedures - Official page opened to start in June - Pre-examination forms can be entered on smartphones, improving management efficiency
summary: 厚生労働省は6月から始まる「予防接種事務のデジタル化」について広く周知するための公式ページを開設した。接種記録の管理、請求や支払い手続きの効率化などをはかることを目指し、全国の市区町村で順次、始められる。
summary_en: The Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare has opened an official page to disseminate information about the ``digitization of vaccination administration'' that will begin in June. Aiming to improve the efficiency of vaccination record management and billing and payment procedures, the system will be gradually rolled out in municipalities across the country.

title: ドコモで通信障害？　SNSでは「つながらない」の声あるも「設備故障は確認できない」　状況確認中
title_en: Communication failure at Docomo? There are comments on SNS that the connection is not possible, but "we cannot confirm that the equipment is out of order." We are currently checking the situation.
summary: NTTドコモは5月19日、携帯電話サービスがつながりにくい可能性について状況確認を開始したと発表した。
summary_en: NTT Docomo announced on May 19th that it has started checking the situation regarding the possibility that mobile phone service may be difficult to connect.

title: 冷房稼働率、早くも20％突破　パナソニックのエアコンアプリ調査で判明
title_en: Cooling operation rate already exceeds 20%, revealed by Panasonic air conditioner app survey
summary: 17日の冷房利用率は平年（12.5％）を8.0ポイント上回っており、例年より早いタイミングで冷房利用が進んだ。
summary_en: The air conditioning usage rate on the 17th was 8.0 points higher than the average year (12.5%), indicating that air conditioning usage was earlier than usual.

title: Googleで「プラダを着た悪魔2」を検索すると……
title_en: When you search for "The Devil Wears Prada 2" on Google...
summary: Google検索で「プラダを着た悪魔2」と検索すると、画面左端から映画を象徴する赤いハイヒールが登場する仕掛けが導入された。この映画は2週連続で週末映画興行収入1位を獲得し、累計興行収入は34億円を突破している。
summary_en: When you search for ``The Devil Wears Prada 2'' on Google, a device has been introduced in which red high heels, the symbol of the movie, appear from the left edge of the screen. The film ranked number one at the weekend box office for two consecutive weeks, and its cumulative box office revenue exceeded 3.4 billion yen.

title: 嵐ラストライブ“無断上映イベント”は「著作権侵害になり得る」　STARTO社が警告
title_en: Arashi's Last Live "Unauthorized screening event" "could be copyright infringement" STARTO warns
summary: 5月31日の「嵐」ラストツアー最終公演について、無断で大画面で上映すると告知している店舗やイベントが多数確認されているという。
summary_en: It has been confirmed that many stores and events have announced that the final performance of Arashi's last tour on May 31st will be shown on a large screen without permission.

title: ChatGPTに資産管理機能まで追加され……マネーフォワードは不要になる？
title_en: Asset management functionality has been added to ChatGPT...will Money Forward become unnecessary?
summary: マネーフォワードを退会した筆者の前に、ChatGPTの資産管理機能が登場。AIがSaaSを飲み込む未来は近いのか、それとも結局元サヤなのか。
summary_en: ChatGPT's asset management function appeared before the author, who had withdrawn from Money Forward. Is the future where AI will swallow up SaaS in the near future, or will it be a former Saya after all?

title: Anthropicの「Mythos」でCloudflareがサイバー防衛テスト──脆弱性発見から悪用までが数分に短縮と警告
title_en: Cloudflare tests cyber defense with Anthropic's Mythos - warns that vulnerability discovery and exploitation can be reduced to minutes
summary: Cloudflareは、AnthropicのAIモデル「Mythos Preview」を用いた脆弱性テスト結果を公開した。同モデルはエクスプロイトチェーン構築やPoC生成で高い能力を示した一方、ガードレールの誤作動も確認された。同社はタスクを細分化するパイプラインの構築や防御層の再構築の必要性を指摘している。
summary_en: Cloudflare has released vulnerability test results using Anthropic's AI model "Mythos Preview." While the model showed high ability in constructing exploit chains and generating PoCs, it was also confirmed that guardrails malfunctioned. The company points out the need to build pipelines that subdivide tasks and rebuild defense layers.

title: 「任天堂のゲームを遊ぶ時間の長さ」はメンタルヘルスに影響するか？　オックスフォード大がカジュアルゲーマー層を調査
title_en: Does “length of time playing Nintendo games” affect mental health? Oxford University surveys casual gamers
summary: 英オックスフォード大学に所属する研究者らがRoyal Society Open Scienceで発表した論文「Perceived value of video games, but not hours played, predicts mental well-being in casual adult Nintendo players」は、　ビデオゲームのプレイ時間とメンタルヘルスの関連性について調査した2025年3月の研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``Perceived value of video games, but not hours played, predicts mental well-being in casual adult Nintendo players,'' published in Royal Society Open Science by researchers affiliated with the University of Oxford in the UK, is a research report published in March 2025 that investigated the relationship between video game playing time and mental health.

title: CodeRabbit が TAKT のスポンサーになりました：せっかくなので CodeRabbit と TAKT を共存させよう
title_en: CodeRabbit becomes a sponsor of TAKT: Let's make CodeRabbit and TAKT coexist!
summary:
はじめに
TAKT が CodeRabbit にスポンサードされることになりました。めでたい。ありがたい。
CodeRabbit は AI がレビューを行うことで開発を支援するサービスです。TAKT は AI コーディングエージェントをオーケストレーションして目的を達成する機能を提供する OSS です。共に AI を活用して開発等を支援するもので、そういった意味では近しいものを感じますね。そんな企業から支援いただけるのは光栄です。

summary_en:
Introduction
TAKT is now sponsored by CodeRabbit. Congratulations. thank you.
CodeRabbit is a service that supports development by performing reviews using AI. TAKT is an OSS that provides the ability to orchestrate AI coding agents to achieve goals. Both utilize AI to support development, etc., so in that sense I feel they are similar. We are honored to receive support from such a company.

title: React CompilerをannotationモードとOxlintで漸進的に導入する
title_en: Gradually introducing React Compiler with annotation mode and Oxlint
summary:
React CompilerをannotationモードとOxlintで漸進的に導入する

 はじめに
こんにちは。ぷーじ（@yug1224）です。
約7,500ファイルのTypeScriptプロジェクトにReact Compilerを導入しました。本記事では、annotationモードとOxlintで、all モードの一括適用ではなく、段階的に Compiler を広げた進め方を紹介します。

 導入の背景
最初は "all" モードをローカルで気軽に試してみたのですが、TanStack Table v8を使ったテーブルが軒並み壊れ、react-hook-formのフォームが無限ルー...
summary_en:
Gradually introducing React Compiler with annotation mode and Oxlint

 Introduction
Hello. This is Puji (@yug1224).
We implemented React Compiler in a TypeScript project with approximately 7,500 files. In this article, we will introduce how to gradually expand the Compiler using annotation mode and Oxlint, rather than applying all mode all at once.

 Background of introduction
At first, I tried "all" mode locally, but all the tables using TanStack Table v8 broke, and the form of react-hook-form became an infinite loop...

title: 回帰分析って知ってる？―完全に理解した人へ贈る絶望の谷
title_en: Do you know about regression analysis? -The Valley of Despair for those who fully understand it
summary:
はじめに

回帰分析って知ってますか？

 
 
こんな質問されたらゾッとしますよね。知らないというわけでもないですが、きっとかなり深いレベルで知っていないとボコボコにされるでしょう。
R言語の lm() や Python の sklearn.LinearRegression() を呼び出して、推定した回帰係数を眺めたことがある、紙とペンでOLSによる係数を求めたことがある、OLS推定量がBLUEであることを確かめた、因果効果を回帰分析で推定した。。。どこまでやれば回帰分析を「知っている」と言って良いのでしょうか。
そんなことは何でも良いのです。とにかく回帰分析は...
summary_en:
Introduction

Do you know about regression analysis?

 
 
It's scary to be asked such a question. It's not that I don't know about it, but I'm sure if I don't know it at a deep level, I'll probably get beaten up.
I have looked at the estimated regression coefficients by calling lm() in R language or sklearn.LinearRegression() in Python, I have calculated coefficients using OLS using pen and paper, I have confirmed that the OLS estimator is BLUE, I have estimated causal effects using regression analysis. . . How far do you have to go to know regression analysis?
Anything like that is fine. Anyway, regression analysis...

title: AIを5本同時に走らせても、俺の脳みそは1個しかない
title_en: Even if I run 5 AIs at the same time, I only have one brain.
summary:
こんにちは。脳みそが1個しかない者です。
これは味噌です
最近、当たり前のように並列開発をするようになりました。皆さんもそうだと思います。cmuxや何なりでAIで5〜6本のタスクを同時に走らせて、サブエージェントも含めると10本以上が同時に動いているみたいな感じです。
燃やし切って退勤する頃には、今日自分が何をしたのか、コードの中身がどうなっているのか、よく思い出せない時もあります。記憶が薄い。
たまに思います。
これ仕事じゃなくてゲームとかYoutubeだったら、お母さんに怒られたんだろうね

 人間は並列処理できない
これ、もう何十年も前から認知科学で言われていることなんですが、改め...
summary_en:
Hello. A person with only one brain.
This is miso
Recently, parallel development has become commonplace. I think everyone does too. With cmux or whatever, AI is running 5-6 tasks at the same time, and if you include subagents, it feels like more than 10 tasks are running at the same time.

summary_en: The Universal Cart, which Google announced at Google I/O 2026, is a shopping cart that allows you to centrally manage products across Google's services such as Search, Gemini, YouTube, and Gmail. Gemini monitors price fluctuations, provides inventory alerts, checks compatibility with cart items in the background, and works with Google Wallet to suggest the best payment method.

title: Antigravity 2.0、IDEが消えた・サインインできない問題の対処法
title_en: Antigravity 2.0, how to deal with the issue of IDE disappearing or not being able to sign in
summary:
!
対象読者: Antigravity 2.0リリース直後にハマっている方

Antigravity 2.0リリース直後、サインインできない・IDEが消えたという報告がコミュニティ・X等で多数上がっている。本記事では原因と対処法を簡潔にまとめた。

 Q. サインインできない
A. アプリを一度終了して再起動する。
認証自体は完了しているがステート管理の問題で画面遷移ができていない状態。再インストール不要。複数回の再起動で解消したケースも報告されている。

 Q. Antigravity IDEがどこかに消えた
A. IDEはなくなっていない。Antigravity 2.0とは別アプリと...
summary_en:
!
Target audience: People who are addicted to Antigravity 2.0 right after its release.

Immediately after the release of Antigravity 2.0, there were many reports in the community, X, etc. that they could not sign in or the IDE disappeared. This article briefly summarizes the causes and solutions.

 Q. I can't sign in.
A. Close the app and restart it.
Authentication itself has been completed, but screen transitions are not possible due to state management issues. No reinstallation required. There have also been reports of cases where the issue was resolved by restarting multiple times.

 Q. Antigravity IDE disappeared somewhere
A. IDEs are not going away. Antigravity 2.0 is a different app...

title: AIでコードが増えていくこの時代に、メンテナンスコスト削減にもAIを
title_en: In this era where AI is increasing the number of codes, AI can also be used to reduce maintenance costs.
summary:
AIにIssueを渡してPRを作らせたり、夜中に作業を進めてもらったりすることが当たり前になり、実装速度が上がっている実感はかなりあります。
一方で、実装速度が上がるほど気になることは、このままのペースで増やしたコードを、来年も同じように直せるんだろうか？という点です。
AIコーディングの話では「どれだけ速く作れたか」が目立ちます。
でも、その裏側にあるメンテナンスコストの存在は忘れられがちです。私も忘れがちです。
圧倒的なスピードでコードを積み重ねる体験はAIコーディングハイです。

しかし、ここを見ないまま生成速度だけを上げると、未来の変更コストを積み増しているだけになりかねません。...
summary_en:
It has become commonplace to hand an issue to AI and have it create a PR or work on it in the middle of the night, and I feel that the speed of implementation has increased considerably.
On the other hand, the more the implementation speed increases, the more I wonder if I will be able to fix the same amount of code next year at the same pace? That's the point.
When it comes to AI coding, what stands out is how fast it can be created.
However, the existence of maintenance costs behind the scenes is often forgotten. I also tend to forget.
The experience of accumulating code at overwhelming speed is AI Coding High.

However, if you only increase the generation speed without looking at this point, you may only be accumulating future change costs. ...

title: パナ健保運営の松下記念病院がUSBメモリ紛失　患者の情報保存　「漏えいは確認していない」
title_en: Matsushita Memorial Hospital operated by Pana Health Insurance Society loses USB memory to store patient information; ``No leaks have been confirmed.''

summary_en: Matsushita Memorial Hospital (Kadoma City, Osaka Prefecture) announced on May 19th that a USB memory containing patient data was lost within the hospital. Contains personal information such as patient ID, name, gender, age, and disease name. The USB memory was password protected and was not taken outside the hospital.

summary_en: Pokémon has announced that it is considering introducing an identity verification system using My Number cards for some services related to the Pokémon card game. It is said that it is aiming to start around August 2026.

title: 民事訴訟全面IT化　訴えられても……確認遅れに注意　最高裁はシステム障害も想定
title_en: Fully IT-based civil litigation Even if you are sued...be careful of delays in confirmation; Supreme Court assumes system failure
summary: 5月21日から始まる民事裁判手続きの全面デジタル化により、書面のやりとりを前提としてきた民事訴訟の実務は大きな転換点を迎える。迅速化・効率化が期待されるが、本格的な運用に当たってはオンラインによる手続きが義務付けられる法曹関係者の習熟やシステムトラブルなどへの対応も求められそうだ。
summary_en: With the full digitalization of civil court proceedings starting May 21st, the practice of civil litigation, which has been based on the exchange of documents, will reach a major turning point. Although it is expected to be faster and more efficient, full-scale implementation will likely require legal professionals to become familiar with online procedures, as well as to deal with system problems.

title: SNSでの落書き動画拡散を受け……京都・伏見稲荷大社が騒動収束を狙い竹を伐採
title_en: After graffiti videos spread on SNS...Kyoto's Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine cuts down bamboo in an effort to end the disturbance
summary: 人気の観光スポットとして知られる伏見稲荷大社（京都市伏見区）で、何者かが境内の竹に落書きをする様子が撮影された動画がSNSで拡散され、騒動を収めるため、神社側が竹を伐採したことが5月20日、関係者への取材で分かった。市内では他の観光地の竹林でも同様の被害が多発。伏見稲荷大社は公式サイトで参拝者に注意を呼びかけている。
summary_en: At Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine (Fushimi Ward, Kyoto City), a popular tourist spot, a video of someone drawing graffiti on bamboo in the precincts went viral on social media, and in an effort to stop the disturbance, the shrine cut down the bamboo, it was revealed through interviews with people involved on May 20th. Similar damage occurred frequently in bamboo forests at other tourist spots in the city. Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine warns worshipers to be careful on its official website.

summary_en: Google announced that it will introduce multiple new ad formats to search using Gemini. In addition to testing a format in which advertisements can be incorporated into answers and recommendation lists generated by AI for "AI Mode," the company will gradually roll out shopping advertisements with automatic explanations and chat-type advertisements for regular searches.

title: GitHub内部リポジトリへの不正アクセス、「悪意あるVS Code拡張機能」が関与と特定　約3800件流出か

summary_en: GitHub announced a follow-up to its investigation into unauthorized access to its internal repositories on its official X account. The company's current opinion is that the route of the breach was an attack on employees' terminals through an extension to the code editor Visual Studio Code, and that the leak was limited to internal repositories. The company said it isolated the compromised device and began security measures.

title: 山手線の車両を5Gの“ミリ波エリア化”　JR東とKDDIが初めて実証──ガラスアンテナで電波を車内に

title: 複数集約を跨ぐ処理を1つのDBトランザクションで括る前に読む記事
title_en: Articles to read before combining processing across multiple aggregations into one DB transaction
summary:
本稿は、DDDの集約モデリング手順や、境界の見つけ方そのものを解説する記事ではない。扱うのは、集約境界と単一DBトランザクション境界を混同したときの波及である。RDBのロックや運用上の負担、読み取り側の公開範囲、プロセスマネージャー設計へ、どのような影響が出るのかを見る。つまり、ドメインモデリングの本質論ではなく、不変条件を実装へ落とす過程で表面化する技術的な論点に焦点を当てる。
本稿の内容は、既存文献から学んだことと、筆者自身の設計・運用上の解釈に基づいている。設計に「常にこうすべき」という絶対解はない。ここで述べるのは、筆者が現時点で妥当だと考えている判断軸である。
というか、かなり...
summary_en:
This article is not an article that explains the DDD aggregation modeling procedure or how to find boundaries itself. We are dealing with the ramifications of confusing aggregate boundaries and single DB transaction boundaries. We will look at the impact on RDB locking, operational burden, disclosure range on the reader side, and process manager design. In other words, the focus is not on the essentials of domain modeling, but on the technical issues that arise in the process of translating invariants into implementation.
The content of this article is based on what I have learned from existing literature and my own interpretation of the design and operation. When it comes to design, there is no absolute solution that says ``it should always be done this way.'' What I will describe here is the judgment axis that I believe is appropriate at this point in time.
In fact, quite...

title: 人生で初めて OSS にコントリビュートした話
title_en: The story of contributing to OSS for the first time in my life
summary:
これは技術の話というより、気持ちの備忘録。
人生で初めて OSS にコントリビュートできたので、その嬉しさが消えないうちに残しておく。

 初めからPR出すつもりではなかった
「よし、OSS に貢献するぞ」と意気込んで始めたわけじゃなかった。
最近の自分は、Hono のエコシステム ── Inertia や hono/jsx を組み合わせたあたり ── をずっと触っている。「これなら自分のやりたいアーキテクチャが作れるんじゃないか」と、あれこれ考えながら実験する日々だった。貢献はゴールじゃなくて、ただ夢中でいじっていただけ。

そうやって手を動かしている...

It was the first time in my life that I was able to contribute to OSS, so I'll leave it to you while I still feel that joy.

I didn't start out thinking, ``Okay, I'm going to contribute to OSS.''
Lately, I've been playing around with the Hono ecosystem -- a combination of Inertia and hono/jsx. I spent my days experimenting and thinking, ``Maybe I can create the architecture I want with this.'' Contributing wasn't my goal, I was just playing around with it obsessively.

summary_en: The Immigration Services Agency has announced plans to strengthen its cyber patrols, which collect and analyze posts on social media, in order to strengthen the detection of foreigners who are illegally overstaying or working illegally. The reason behind the increased surveillance is that for foreigners living in Japan, SNS has not only become a communication tool that allows them to communicate directly with their fellow citizens in their native language, but also connects some illegal overstayers and has become a breeding ground for criminal activities such as illegal employment and underground part-time jobs.

summary_en: The paper ``Emergence of economic and social disparities through competitive gift-giving'' published in PLOS Complex Systems in 2024 by researchers affiliated with the Graduate School of the University of Tokyo is a research report that expresses status competition through gifts using a mathematical model and uses computer simulations to clarify how the social structure changes.

We will introduce a model in which the profits generated from AI-driven derivative works will be directly distributed to artists, with a system based on the consent of rights holders and fair compensation.

In conjunction with this, IBM will establish a new company, Anderon, the first dedicated quantum chip foundry in the United States, with a $1 billion grant from the Department of Commerce and its own investment.

While I was thinking that it was time to take the AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional, I suddenly remembered the common controversy over whether or not a qualification is necessary, so I wrote a poem.
Personally, I have obtained all AWS certifications since 2023. It's a so-called complete crown. Originally, I wasn't interested in winning all the titles, but one day I realized that I was jealous of the gold jackets that people who had won all the titles received, and since I regularly take AWS certification exams to evaluate the company, I thought I could have won all the titles if I tried a little harder, so I decided to take on the challenge.

title: AIに投げても解けなかったGPSアート自動生成を、最適化問題として組み立て直した話
title_en: A story about reassembling automatic GPS art generation as an optimization problem that could not be solved even when submitted to AI.
summary:
はじめに

しかし実際にプロンプトエンジニアリングを突き詰めていくと、システムプロンプトの構造化や RAG のチャンク設計という特定の用途に絞った文脈では、構造が複雑なコンテキストほど HTML や XML ライクな構造で渡したほうが AI の解釈精度が上がる という経験則に直面することがある。

summary_en:
Introduction
``If I write it in Markdown, it will be easier for AI to read.'' I'm sure there are many people who have thought so and have prepared the source documents for CLAUDE.md and RAG in Markdown.
However, when we actually delve into prompt engineering, in the context of a specific use such as structuring system prompts or designing RAG chunks, we may come across the empirical rule that the more complex the structure, the more accurate the AI ​​interpretation will be if the context is passed in an HTML or XML-like structure.
In this article, we will discuss ``Why HTML can be more advantageous for AI than Markdown in certain scenarios,'' based on language design and LLM studies.

title: 「URLを誰にも教えてない」が通じない理由 — CTログを30分監視してみた
title_en: Why "I haven't told anyone the URL" doesn't work - I monitored the CT log for 30 minutes
summary:
独自ドメインを取ってWebサイト/アプリを公開するとき、「URL(ドメイン)を誰にも教えていないから大丈夫」と油断していませんか？
結論から言うと、これは成り立ちません。
独自ドメインを取って HTTPS の証明書を発行すると、その時点でドメイン名は CT（Certificate Transparency）ログという公開ログに記録されます。
このログを監視しているbotは大量に存在していて、新しく現れたドメインに対して自動でアクセスを試みています。
実際にどんな景色になっているのか気になったので、CTログを30分間監視して、新規ドメインを観測してみました。
倫理・法律の境界線を守りながら...
summary_en:
When you get your own domain and publish your website/app, do you get careless and think, ``It's okay because I haven't told anyone the URL (domain)?''
In conclusion, this doesn't hold true.
When you take your own domain and issue an HTTPS certificate, at that point the domain name is recorded in a public log called the CT (Certificate Transparency) log.
There are a large number of bots monitoring this log and automatically attempting to access newly appeared domains.
I was curious about what the scene actually looked like, so I monitored the CT log for 30 minutes and observed new domains.
While adhering to ethical and legal boundaries...

summary: Metaは、FacebookやInstagramなどに新たな定額制サービス「Plus」を導入すると発表した。最終的にこれらを「Meta One」ブランドに一本化する方針だ。広告依存からの脱却と収益多角化が目的で、一般向けのほか、高度なAI機能が使えるプラン、ビジネス向けプランなどもテスト展開する。
summary_en: Meta announced that it will introduce a new flat-rate service called "Plus" for Facebook, Instagram, etc. The plan is to eventually unify these under the "Meta One" brand. The aim is to break away from advertising dependence and diversify revenue, and in addition to plans for the general public, plans that can use advanced AI functions and plans for business will be rolled out on a test basis.

title: 毎日500mlの「炭酸水」で間食と飲酒が減る？　アサヒ飲料などが学術誌で研究発表
title_en: Will 500ml of carbonated water every day reduce snacking and drinking? Asahi Soft Drinks and others publish research in academic journals
summary: No Summary Available
summary_en: No Summary Available

title: YouTube、AIで生成した動画を自動検出してラベル表示──クリエイターの申告なしでも
title_en: YouTube automatically detects and labels videos generated by AI - even without the creator's notification
summary: YouTubeは、動画にリアルなAIが使われていることを検知した場合、ラベルを自動適用すると発表した。これまではクリエイターの自己申告に依存していたが、システムによる自動検出を順次開始する。また、通常の動画ではプレーヤー直下に、ショート動画では映像上に重ねるなど、表示位置もより目立つ形に変更する。
summary_en: YouTube has announced that it will automatically apply labels to videos if it detects that they use realistic AI. Until now, it has relied on creators' self-reports, but the system will gradually begin automatic detection. Additionally, the display position will be changed to be more prominent, such as directly below the player for regular videos, and overlaid on top of the video for short videos.

title: バラの香り、脳の萎縮を防ぎ認知症予防に役立つ可能性　京大などが2024年に研究発表　1カ月嗅ぐと脳に影響
title_en: The scent of roses may help prevent brain atrophy and prevent dementia. Kyoto University and others will publish research in 2024. Smell of roses for one month affects the brain.
summary: 京都大学などに所属する研究者らが2024年3月に発表した論文「Continuous inhalation of essential oil increases gray matter volume」は、バラの香りを嗅ぎ続けると脳の構造がどうなるかを分析した研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``Continuous inhalation of essential oil increases gray matter volume,'' published in March 2024 by researchers affiliated with Kyoto University and other institutions, is a research report that analyzes what happens to the structure of the brain when people continue to smell roses.

title: 在日米海軍、公式Xが乗っ取り被害　プロフィールなど復旧するもIDは現時点で戻らず
title_en: U.S. Navy in Japan was hijacked by Official
summary: 在日米海軍司令部（CNFJ）の公式Xアカウントが5月27日、何者かに乗っ取られた。同司令部はアカウントを奪還し、プロフィール画像や紹介文は元に戻したが、アカウント名「@CNFJ」は復元できていない。
summary_en: On May 27th, the official X account of the US Naval Forces Japan (CNFJ) was hijacked by someone. The command regained the account and restored the profile image and introduction, but the account name "@CNFJ" has not been restored.

title: 「とらのあな」電子書籍サービス再開　不正クローリング検知から5日ぶり
title_en: "Toranoana" e-book service resumed 5 days after unauthorized crawling was detected
summary: 同人ショップ「とらのあな」などを運営する虎の穴は5月27日、外部からの不正な自動アクセスを検知して一時停止していた電子書籍サービスを、同日午後3時に再開した。
summary_en: On May 27, Toranoana, which operates doujin shops such as Toranoana, resumed its e-book service at 3 p.m. on the same day, after it had been temporarily suspended after detecting unauthorized automated access from outside.

title: 「この答弁はAIが原案作成」　参院本会議で松本デジタル相「職員が事実確認し私が決済」
title_en: "This answer was drafted by AI" Digital Minister Matsumoto said at the plenary session of the House of Councilors: "The staff will confirm the facts and I will make the payment."
summary: 5月から全府省庁で実証事業を開始している行政用の生成AI基盤「源内」について、5月27日の参院本会議で参政党の梅村みずほ氏が活用状況を尋ねたのに対し、松本尚デジタル相は「この答弁も源内が原案を作成した」と述べた。
summary_en: At a plenary session of the House of Councilors on May 27, Mizuho Umemura, a member of the parliamentary party, asked about the state of utilization of Gennai, a generative AI platform for government that has been tested in all ministries and agencies since May, and Digital Minister Hisashi Matsumoto said, ``Gennai also drafted this answer.''

title: 富士通が「Claude」全社展開へ　Anthropicと戦略提携、最新モデルへの早期アクセスも
title_en: Fujitsu to roll out “Claude” company-wide, strategic partnership with Anthropic, early access to the latest models
summary: 富士通は5月27日、米AI企業Anthropicと戦略的パートナーシップ契約を締結したと発表した。生成AI「Claude」を富士通グループ全社員約10万人に展開するほか、重要インフラ向けAI活用やサイバー防御強化を進める。
summary_en: Fujitsu announced on May 27th that it has entered into a strategic partnership agreement with US AI company Anthropic. In addition to deploying the generative AI "Claude" to approximately 100,000 Fujitsu Group employees, the company will also promote the use of AI for critical infrastructure and strengthen cyber defense.

title: 電子雑誌「どこでもヤングチャンピオン」休刊へ　ページ増えすぎ容量過多で配信できず
title_en: E-magazine "Anywhere Young Champion" to be discontinued. Unable to distribute due to too many pages.
summary: 秋田書店は26日、電子マンガ雑誌「どこでもヤングチャンピオン」を配信中の6月号をもって休刊すると発表した。
summary_en: Akita Shoten announced on the 26th that the electronic manga magazine ``Anywhere Young Champion'' will be discontinued after the June issue, which is currently being distributed.

title: NotebookLMの「ソースが古いまま」問題が起こらないように　Googleドライブのファイル更新を自動で反映
title_en: Automatically reflect file updates in Google Drive to prevent NotebookLM's "source remains outdated" problem
summary: 米Googleは5月26日、「NotebookLM」にGoogleドライブとの自動同期機能を追加すると発表した。今後はドライブ上のファイルの変更をNotebookLMにも自動で反映する。
summary_en: Google announced on May 26th that it will add an automatic synchronization function with Google Drive to NotebookLM. From now on, changes to files on Drive will be automatically reflected in NotebookLM.

title: JALグループ、月面輸送に参入　「メビウスの方舟」で地球文化を次世代へ　ispaceと連携
title_en: JAL Group enters lunar transportation, bringing global culture to the next generation with "Mobius Ark" in collaboration with ispace
summary: 航空会社が月面輸送サービスを提供するのは世界初としている。
summary_en: This is the world's first airline to provide lunar transportation services.

title: JR西日本、VRChatで“終電後の広島駅”を再現　「バーチャル広島駅 2.u」公開
title_en: JR West releases “Virtual Hiroshima Station 2.u”, recreating “Hiroshima Station after the last train” with VRChat
summary: JR西日本グループは5月26日、ソーシャルVRプラットフォーム「VRChat」で新ワールド「バーチャル広島駅 2.u」を5月27日に公開すると発表した。終電後の広島駅をテーマにした没入型空間で、創作展示や交流イベントにも対応する。
summary_en: JR West Group announced on May 26th that it will release a new world "Virtual Hiroshima Station 2.u" on May 27th on the social VR platform "VRChat". It is an immersive space themed after Hiroshima Station after the last train, and will also accommodate creative exhibitions and exchange events.

title: ヒト型AIロボスタートアップのアトムが30億円調達　「日本のGDPを1％アップ」目指す
title_en: Atom, a humanoid AI robot startup, raises 3 billion yen, aiming to “increase Japan’s GDP by 1%”
summary: ヒューマノイドAIロボットを開発するアトム（東京都江東区）は5月27日、開発着手とあわせて、シードラウンドで総額30億円を調達したと発表した。製造業や物流・運輸の現場で使えるロボットを開発し、将来の量産化を目指す。
summary_en: On May 27, Astro Boy (Koto-ku, Tokyo), which develops humanoid AI robots, announced that it had begun development and had raised a total of 3 billion yen in a seed round. The company aims to develop robots that can be used in manufacturing, logistics, and transportation, and to mass-produce them in the future.

title: “未知の遺跡”をAIと地形データで発見──奈良文化財研究所　一般の人の取り組みにも期待
title_en: Discovering “unknown ruins” using AI and topographical data—Nara National Research Institute for Cultural Properties has high expectations for the efforts of ordinary people
summary: 高精度な3次元の地形データを活用し、AIによる分析で古墳を発見する研究について、奈良文化財研究所の高田祐一主任研究員に話を聞いた。歴史研究を加速させ、文化財保護にもつながる取り組みだという。
summary_en: We spoke to Yuichi Takada, chief researcher at the Nara National Research Institute for Cultural Properties, about research that uses highly accurate 3D topographical data to discover ancient tombs through AI analysis. The project is said to accelerate historical research and help protect cultural properties.

title: 「レンタルスペースに来たらぐちゃぐちゃ」「諦めて退室したら半額請求」問題、スペースマーケットなど謝罪
title_en: ``When you come to the rental space, it's a mess'' ``If you give up and leave, you're charged half the price'' issue, Space Market apologizes
summary: 前の利用者が残したバルーンやゴミが乱雑に放置され、床も濡れており利用できない状態で清掃を求められ、利用せず退室したところ半額が請求されたという。
summary_en: Balloons and trash left by the previous user were left in a mess, and the floor was wet and unusable. He was asked to clean the room, and when he left the room without using it, he was charged half the price.

title: Google、Workspaceアプリのアイコン刷新　Gmail、カレンダーなど一斉にデザイン変更
title_en: Google redesigns Workspace app icons - Gmail, Calendar, etc. redesigned all at once
summary: 米Googleは5月26日（現地時間）、Google Workspaceアプリのアイコンデザイン刷新を発表した。GmailやGoogleカレンダー、Google Meetなどの主要アプリが対象。
summary_en: On May 26th (local time), Google announced an updated icon design for the Google Workspace app. This applies to major apps such as Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Meet.

title: 選挙の公正確保を　“虚偽”SNS対策が判明、AI生成動画像に改変表示義務付け　与野党案
title_en: To ensure the fairness of elections, “false” SNS measures have been discovered, and the ruling and opposition parties plan to require AI-generated videos to be altered and displayed
summary: 選挙期間中のSNSでの偽・誤情報拡散対策として、与野党による選挙運動に関する協議会で検討が進められていた関連法改正案の骨子の全容が5月26日、分かった。
summary_en: On May 26th, the full outline of a bill to revise related laws, which was being considered by the ruling and opposition parties' election campaign council as a measure to prevent the spread of false and misinformation on social media during the election period, was revealed.

title: 「小説家になろう」、AI利用状況を報告必須に　未設定だと9月から投稿不可
title_en: "Let's Become a Novelist" requires reporting of AI usage status; if not set, posting will not be possible from September
summary: Web小説投稿サイト「小説家になろう」の運営は5月26日、作品創作におけるAI利用状況の設定を必須化すると発表した。6月9日に新設する設定項目で、AIの関与度に応じた4区分から選ばせる。利用度が高い作品はキーワード欄などで開示する。
summary_en: On May 26th, the operator of the web novel submission site ``Let's Become a Novelist'' announced that it will be mandatory to set the status of AI usage in the creation of works. A new setting item that will be added on June 9th will allow users to choose from four categories depending on the degree of AI involvement. Works that are frequently used will be disclosed in the keyword column.

title: ロッキング・オン・ジャパン、元従業員が個人情報をUSBメモリで持ち出し　退職時に
title_en: Former Rocking on Japan employee took personal information with him on USB memory when he left the company
summary: フェス参加者など一般ユーザーの情報は含まれておらず、情報が二次利用された形跡もないと説明している。
summary_en: The company explains that it does not contain information about general users such as festival participants, and there is no evidence that the information was used for secondary purposes.

title: 正社員の5人に1人が「六月病」経験　6月前後にモチベ低下や疲労感
title_en: One out of five full-time employees experiences “June sickness” - a decline in motivation and fatigue around June
summary: 6月前後にモチベーションの低下や疲労感を自覚する「六月病」を、正社員の19.8％が経験している――マイナビは5月26日、こんな調査結果を発表した。
summary_en: Mynavi announced the results of a survey on May 26th: 19.8% of full-time employees experience ``June sickness,'' in which they notice a decline in motivation and fatigue around June.

title: 「食品減税」と「所得連動給付」どっちがお得？　年収などから分かるシミュレータ、チームみらいが公開
title_en: Which is better, “food tax reduction” or “income-linked benefit”? Team Mirai releases a simulator based on annual income etc.
summary: チームみらが「社会保障国民会議 つなぎ施策シミュレーター」を公開した。
summary_en: Team Mira has released the ``Social Security National Council Bridging Measures Simulator''.

title: Dropboxの共同創業者、ヒューストンCEOが退任して会長へ
title_en: Dropbox co-founder and CEO Houston steps down to become chairman
summary: Dropboxは、共同創業者で現CEOのドリュー・ヒューストン氏が退任して取締役会長に就任すると発表した。後任には現製品責任者のアシュラフ・アルカルミ氏が指名され、共同CEO期間を経て単独CEOに就任する。アルカルミ氏の後任にはGoogleのChrome担当VPだったマイク・トーレス氏が就く。
summary_en: Dropbox announced that co-founder and current CEO Drew Houston will step down to become chairman of the company's board. Current product manager Ashraf Alkarmi will be appointed as his successor, and after a period of joint CEOship, he will become sole CEO. Alkarmi will be replaced by Mike Torres, who was Google's VP of Chrome.

title: 子どものジャンクフード、脳に影響残る？　大人になっても過食グセ　Nature系列誌に掲載　マウスは腸内細菌で正常化に成功
title_en: Does junk food affect children's brains? Overeating habit even as an adult Published in Nature series Mice successfully normalize with intestinal bacteria
summary: アイルランドのユニバーシティ・カレッジ・コークなどに所属する研究者らがNature Communicationsで発表した論文「Bifidobacterium longum and prebiotic interventions restore early-life high-fat/high-sugar diet-induced alterations in feeding behavior in adult mice」は、幼少期に脂肪や砂糖を多く含むジャンクフードなどの不健康な食事をとることは、大人になってからの食行動にまで長期的な悪影響を及ぼすことを明らかにした研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper, ``Bifidobacterium longum and prebiotic interventions restore early-life high-fat/high-sugar diet-induced alterations in feeding behavior in adult mice,'' published in Nature Communications by researchers affiliated with University College Cork in Ireland, reveals that eating unhealthy diets such as junk food high in fat and sugar during childhood has a long-term negative impact on eating behavior as an adult.

title: “週4日勤務”が想像以上の成功──「給与100％／労働時間80％／生産性100％」を豪州15社が実施　学術誌にも掲載
title_en: ``Four-day work week'' has been more successful than expected - ``100% salary / 80% working hours / 100% productivity'' implemented by 15 Australian companies, also published in academic journals
summary: オーストラリアのディーキン大学やスウィンバーン工科大学に所属する研究者らがSpringer Nature発行の学術誌Humanities and Social Sciences Communicationsで発表した論文「The four-day workweek in Australia: insights from early adopters of the 100:80:100 model」は、週休3日制を実際に導入したオーストラリアの企業15社の生の声から、その効果や課題を分析した研究報告だ。
summary_en: The paper ``The four-day workweek in Australia: insights from early adopters of the 100:80:100 model,'' published by researchers from Deakin University and Swinburne University of Technology in the academic journal Humanities and Social Sciences Communications published by Springer Nature, is a research report that analyzes the effects and challenges of 15 Australian companies that have actually introduced a three-day work week.

title: IPOを控えるSpaceXの「Starlink」、アメリカン航空も採用へ
title_en: SpaceX's "Starlink" ahead of IPO, American Airlines to adopt
summary: アメリカン航空は、SpaceXの衛星通信網「Starlink」を500機以上のナローボディ機に導入すると発表した。2027年第1四半期から搭載を開始し、対象機では会員向けに無料で高速Wi-Fiを提供する。Starlinkは航空会社との契約を拡大しており、来月のIPOへの追い風となる。
summary_en: American Airlines announced it will install SpaceX's Starlink satellite communications network on more than 500 narrow-body aircraft. Installation will begin in the first quarter of 2027, and eligible aircraft will provide free high-speed Wi-Fi to members. Starlink is expanding its deals with airlines, providing a tailwind for next month's IPO.

title: レンズ交換式もある「GoPro MISSION 1」は映像表現の幅を広げる小さなシネマカメラだった
title_en: The GoPro MISSION 1, which also has interchangeable lenses, was a small cinema camera that expanded the range of video expression.
summary: 米GoProが日本で「GoPro MISSION 1」をお披露目。なぜHEROではなく、MISSION 1という新しいシリーズを加えたのか。そこも含めてハンズオンイベントをリポート。
summary_en: US GoPro unveils "GoPro MISSION 1" in Japan. Why did they add a new series called MISSION 1 instead of HERO? We will report on hands-on events including that.

title: スクエニ、27日午後10時から「ドラゴンクエストからのお知らせ」プレミア公開
title_en: Square Enix will premiere “Notices from Dragon Quest” on the 27th at 10 p.m.
summary: スクウェア・エニックスは、「ドラゴンクエスト」の公式Xアカウントで27日の午後10時からYouTubeで「ドラゴンクエストからのお知らせ」を配信すると明らかにした。
summary_en: Square Enix has announced that the official Dragon Quest X account will be broadcasting ``Notices from Dragon Quest'' on YouTube from 10pm on the 27th.

title: 「プレイ時間50時間以上」を削除　任天堂、マイニンテンドーストアでの「Switch 2」購入条件を緩和
title_en: Removed “50 hours or more of play time” Nintendo relaxes purchase conditions for “Switch 2” on My Nintendo Store
summary: 任天堂は25日、直販サイト「マイニンテンドーストア」における「Nintendo Switch 2」購入時の必要条件を一部緩和した。「プレイ時間50時間以上」を削除している。
summary_en: On the 25th, Nintendo relaxed some of the requirements for purchasing the Nintendo Switch 2 on its direct sales site, My Nintendo Store. "More than 50 hours of play time" has been deleted.

title: ファーウェイ、半導体で「1.4nm相当」目指す　31年までに　「ムーアの法則」に代わる新法則を提唱
title_en: Huawei aims to achieve ``1.4nm equivalent'' in semiconductors by 2031, proposing a new law to replace ``Moore's Law''
summary: 中国Huaweiが半導体進化の新法則「τスケーリング法則」を提唱した。従来の微細化に代わり信号遅延を圧縮しトランジスタ密度を向上させる。秋のKirinチップに独自の回路技術LogicFoldingを初適用し、2031年に1.4nm相当の密度を目指すという。
summary_en: China's Huawei has proposed a new law for semiconductor evolution, the τ scaling law. Instead of conventional miniaturization, it compresses signal delay and improves transistor density. The company will apply its unique circuit technology LogicFolding for the first time to the Kirin chip in the fall, aiming for a density equivalent to 1.4nm in 2031.

title: PIXTA、AI生成素材の販売終了　「購入者が求めるのは人の手による作品」
title_en: PIXTA ends sales of AI-generated materials: "Purchasers are looking for works made by humans"
summary: ピクスタは、写真・イラスト素材のマーケットプレイス「PIXTA」で、5月22日をもって「AI生成素材」の取り扱いを終了したと発表した。
summary_en: PIXTA has announced that it will no longer accept AI-generated materials on its photo and illustration marketplace PIXTA as of May 22nd.

title: X、無断転載する大型アカウントの収益化を大幅制限へ　元の投稿者にインプレッションを還元
title_en: X will significantly restrict the monetization of large accounts that reproduce without permission. Impressions will be returned to the original poster.
summary: 米Xのプロダクト責任者Nikita Bier氏は5月23日、収益分配プログラムを悪用する大型アカウントが小規模アカウントの投稿を自動で再アップロードし、投稿元を明かさずに収益化する回避行為を過去1カ月で多数特定したと自身のXで明かした。該当投稿のインプレッションを元の投稿者に割り当て始めたという。
summary_en: On May 23, Nikita Bier, head of product at U.S. The company has started assigning impressions for the relevant posts to the original poster.

title: 総務省、海底ケーブルの防御対策、骨子案を取りまとめ　地方分散で多ルート化
title_en: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications compiles outline proposals for submarine cable defense measures, creating multiple routes with regional distribution
summary: 総務省が国際海底ケーブルの防御を議論する有識者会議を開き、関連施設の地方分散など、対策の骨子案を了承した。今夏にも報告書を取りまとめる。海底ケーブルの重要性が高まる中、破壊工作で想定される被害も深刻化、事業者に多ルート化などを支援し、官民連携で陸揚局などを防御する。
summary_en: The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications held a meeting of experts to discuss the protection of international submarine cables, and approved the outline of countermeasures such as dispersing related facilities to regional areas. A report will be compiled this summer. As the importance of submarine cables increases, the potential damage caused by sabotage is also becoming more serious, so we will support operators in creating multiple routes and protect landing stations through public-private collaboration.

title: イランのネット接続が再開へ　大統領が承認、戦争後に海外サイトから3カ月遮断
title_en: Iran's internet connection to be resumed; president approves, blocked from foreign sites for 3 months after war
summary: 国営イラン通信が、ペゼシュキアン大統領が国際インターネットのアクセスを再開するよう命じたと報じた。イランでは米イスラエルとの戦争開始後の2月末以降、約3カ月間にわたり、国内から海外のサイトやネットワークへの接続が遮断されていた。
summary_en: Iranian state news agency reported that President Pezeshkian ordered international internet access to be restored. In Iran, connections from domestic sites to overseas sites and networks have been cut off for about three months since the beginning of the war with the United States and Israel at the end of February.

title: スカパー！、交流戦の一部試合でチャット機能を停止　巨人戦など
title_en: SKY PerfecTV! , the chat function has been suspended for some games such as games against the Giants.
summary: 「諸般の事情」とし、理由は明かしていない。

title: 【GitHub Actions】actions/checkout には persist-credentials: false を設定するべき

on: ...

  with:

title: KubernetesでMinecraftサーバーを運用すると何が難しいのか
title_en: What are the difficulties of running a Minecraft server on Kubernetes?
summary:
KubernetesでMinecraftサーバーを運用すると何が難しいのか
Minecraftサーバーは、Dockerを使えば比較的簡単に動かせます。
Docker Composeで環境変数を指定し、ボリュームをマウントして起動すれば、個人サーバーとしては十分に便利です。
しかし、これをKubernetes上で「運用」しようとすると、見える問題が変わります。
Podは再作成されます。Deploymentは再デプロイされます。world dataはPVCに残ります。設定やpluginsは更新されます。終了時に保存処理が失敗すると、worldやpluginsの状態に影響することもあります...
summary_en:
What are the difficulties of running a Minecraft server on Kubernetes?
Running a Minecraft server is relatively easy using Docker.
If you specify environment variables with Docker Compose, mount the volume, and start it, it is convenient enough for a personal server.
However, when you try to "operate" this on Kubernetes, the visible problem changes.
The Pod will be recreated. The Deployment will be redeployed. world data remains in PVC. Settings and plugins will be updated. If the save process fails on exit, it can also affect the state of the world and plugins...

title: 社内の知見をAIが漏らさず拾う唯一の設計思想 ― Karpathy氏のLLM Wikiを実践して分かったこと
title_en: The only design philosophy that allows AI to pick up internal knowledge without leaking it - What I learned from implementing Mr. Karpathy's LLM Wiki
summary:
健適文化という会社をやっています。社内ドキュメントが散らかって検索できない、AIに聞いてもまともな答えが返ってこない、そういう課題に対して、会社のナレッジベースをゼロから構築するお手伝いをしています。この記事はその過程で得た知見をまとめたものです。

 先に結論
社内ドキュメントをベクトルDBに突っ込んでRAGを組んだのに精度が出ない、という問題の原因は「入れ方」にあります。生のドキュメントをそのまま渡すのではなく、LLMが消化できる粒度まで段階的に加工してから渡す。Anthropicがコンテキストエンジニアリングの文脈でprogressive disclosureと呼んでいる設計思想で...
summary_en:
I run a company called Kenteki Bunka. We help companies build a knowledge base from scratch to solve problems such as internal documents being scattered and unsearchable, and AI not being able to give you a proper answer when you ask a question. This article is a summary of what we learned along the way.

 Conclusion first
The cause of the problem of not being able to obtain accuracy even after inserting in-house documents into a vector DB and creating a RAG is due to the "method of input." Rather than handing over the raw document as is, it is processed step by step to a level that the LLM can digest before handing it over. A design philosophy that Anthropic calls progressive disclosure in the context of context engineering...

title: 仕様駆動開発最前線 — SDLC を一周描き直す Living Book
title_en: The forefront of specification-driven development — Living Book that redraws the SDLC full circle
summary: AI コーディングエージェントを生産性の核に据えるための SDLC 一周分の再設計を、Anthropic / Atlassian / Cloudflare / CodeRabbit / arXiv などの公開資料を実務経験で取捨選択・解釈した編纂物として描く Living Book。 仕様策定の特性違い(新規 vs 既存改修)、SDD に必要な役割整理、Living Specs の維持、UI デザイン律速の解消、仕様受領後の着手前準備、コーディング中のエージェント運用、テスト戦略(Pyramid → Trophy / Honeycomb)、レビュー自動化、Feature Flag と Progressive Delivery を含むリリースマネジメント、AI 文脈ログ設計、SDD プロセス自体の可観測性まで SDLC を一周。 完成を待たず暫定方針で公開し、検証データの蓄積に応じて継続改訂する。
summary_en: Living Book depicts the redesign of one round of SDLC to put AI coding agents at the core of productivity as a compilation of public materials such as Anthropic / Atlassian / Cloudflare / CodeRabbit / arXiv selected and interpreted based on practical experience. We covered SDLC, including differences in the characteristics of specification development (new vs. existing modification), role organization required for SDD, maintenance of Living Specs, resolution of UI design rate-limiting, pre-start preparation after specification receipt, agent operation during coding, test strategy (Pyramid → Trophy / Honeycomb), review automation, release management including Feature Flag and Progressive Delivery, AI context log design, and observability of the SDD process itself. It will be released as a provisional policy without waiting for completion, and will be continually revised as verification data accumulates.

title: 1日で作るサプライチェーン攻撃対策！運用死しないコスト「ほぼゼロ」の通信監視
summary:
1. はじめに

This is a story about introducing a machine learning model to determine the hold and tap of a 40% keyboard.

 What is Tap & Hold?
Tap&Hold is a function that assigns two key roles to one key.

summary_en:
Have you ever experienced something like this?
Monday morning, I launch Claude Code.

"Do you remember how you fixed that bug you fixed last week?"

Claude: Sorry, we don't have access to the content of past sessions.
        Could you please tell me again what the problem was?
...This is it again. I gave the same explanation last week and the week before that.
I use Claude Code every day. And every day, they repeat the same explanation to the same AI over and over again. I told them, ``If you rotate JWT_SECRET, all sessions will be invalidated, so redeploy them in parallel.''
